4.19.s:
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ..
ekadā bālakaiḥ sārdhaṃ baladevaṃ vinā hariḥ ..
jagāma yamunātīraṃ yatra kāliyamandiram .. 1 ..
4.19.d:
श्रीनारायण उवाच ॥
एकदा बालकैः सार्धं बलदेवं विना हरिः ॥
जगाम यमुनातीरं यत्र कालियमन्दिरम् ॥ 1 ॥

4.19.s:
paripakvaphalaṃ bhuktvā yamunātīraje vane ..
svecchāmayastṛṭparītaḥ papau ca nirmalaṃ jalam .. 2 ..
4.19.d:
परिपक्वफलं भुक्त्वा यमुनातीरजे वने ॥
स्वेच्छामयस्तृट्परीतः पपौ च निर्मलं जलम् ॥ 2 ॥

4.19.s:
gokulaṃ cārayāmāsa śiśubhiḥ saha kānane ..
vijahāra ca taiḥ sārddhaṃ sthāpayāmāsa gokulam .. 3 ..
4.19.d:
गोकुलं चारयामास शिशुभिः सह कानने ॥
विजहार च तैः सार्द्धं स्थापयामास गोकुलम् ॥ 3 ॥

4.19.s:
krīḍānimagnacitto'yaṃ bālakāśca mudā'nvitāḥ ..
bhuktvā navatṛṇaṃ gāvo viṣatoyaṃ papurmune ..4 ..
4.19.d:
क्रीडानिमग्नचित्तोऽयं बालकाश्च मुदाऽन्विताः ॥
भुक्त्वा नवतृणं गावो विषतोयं पपुर्मुने ॥4 ॥

4.19.s:
viṣāktaṃ ca jalaṃ pītvā dāruṇāntakaceṣṭayā ..
jvālābhiḥ kālakūṭānāṃ sadyaḥ prāṇāṃśca tatyajuḥ ..5..
4.19.d:
विषाक्तं च जलं पीत्वा दारुणान्तकचेष्टया ॥
ज्वालाभिः कालकूटानां सद्यः प्राणांश्च तत्यजुः ॥5॥

4.19.s:
dṛṣṭvā mṛtaṃ gosamūhaṃ gopāścintākulā bhiyā ..
viṣaṇṇavadanāḥ sarve tamūcumardhusūdanam .. 6 ..
4.19.d:
दृष्ट्वा मृतं गोसमूहं गोपाश्चिन्ताकुला भिया ॥
विषण्णवदनाः सर्वे तमूचुमर्धुसूदनम् ॥ 6 ॥

4.19.s:
jñātvā sarvaṃ jagannātho jīvayāmāsa gokulam ..
uttasthustatkṣaṇaṃ gāvo dadṛśuḥ śrīharermukham ..7..
4.19.d:
ज्ञात्वा सर्वं जगन्नाथो जीवयामास गोकुलम् ॥
उत्तस्थुस्तत्क्षणं गावो ददृशुः श्रीहरेर्मुखम् ॥7॥

4.19.s:
kṛṣṇaḥ kadambamāruhya yamunānīratīrajam ..
papāta sarpabhavane nāgamadhye narākṛtiḥ .. 8 ..
4.19.d:
कृष्णः कदम्बमारुह्य यमुनानीरतीरजम् ॥
पपात सर्पभवने नागमध्ये नराकृतिः ॥ 8 ॥

4.19.s:
śatahastapramāṇaṃ ca jalotthānaṃ babhūva ha ..
bālā harṣaṃ viṣādaṃ ca menire tatra nārada .. 9 ..
4.19.d:
शतहस्तप्रमाणं च जलोत्थानं बभूव ह ॥
बाला हर्षं विषादं च मेनिरे तत्र नारद ॥ 9 ॥

4.19.s:
sarpo narākṛtiṃ dṛṣṭvā kāliyaḥ krodhavihvalaḥ ..
jagrāha śrīhariṃ tūrṇaṃ taptalohaṃ yathā naraḥ .. 4.19.10 ..
4.19.d:
सर्पो नराकृतिं दृष्ट्वा कालियः क्रोधविह्वलः ॥
जग्राह श्रीहरिं तूर्णं तप्तलोहं यथा नरः ॥ 4.19.10 ॥

4.19.s:
dagdhakaṇṭhodaro nāgaścodvigno brahmatejasā ..
prāṇā yāntyevamuktvā ca cakārodvamanaṃ punaḥ .. 11 ..
4.19.d:
दग्धकण्ठोदरो नागश्चोद्विग्नो ब्रह्मतेजसा ॥
प्राणा यान्त्येवमुक्त्वा च चकारोद्वमनं पुनः ॥ 11 ॥

4.19.s:
bhagnadanto raktamukhaḥ kṛṣṇavajrāṅgacarvaṇāt ..
raktavaktrasya bhagavānuttasthau mastakopari ..12..
4.19.d:
भग्नदन्तो रक्तमुखः कृष्णवज्राङ्गचर्वणात् ॥
रक्तवक्त्रस्य भगवानुत्तस्थौ मस्तकोपरि ॥12॥
4.19.m:
With broken teeth and a bloody mouth from chewing the adamantine body of Kṛṣṇa,
upon the head of the one whose mouth was bloody, the Blessed Lord stood up.

4.19.s:
nāgo viśvaṃbharākrāntaḥ sa prāṇāṃstyaktumudyataḥ ..
cakāra raktodvamanaṃ papāta mūrcchito mune .. 13 ..
4.19.d:
नागो विश्वंभराक्रान्तः स प्राणांस्त्यक्तुमुद्यतः ॥
चकार रक्तोद्वमनं पपात मूर्च्छितो मुने ॥ 13 ॥
4.19.m:
The serpent, crushed by the supporter of the universe, ready to give up his life,
vomited blood and fell unconscious, O sage.

4.19.s: dṛṣṭvā taṃ mūrchitaṃ nāgā ruruduḥ premavihvalāḥ .. 14 ..
4.19.d: दृष्ट्वा तं मूर्छितं नागा रुरुदुः प्रेमविह्वलाः ॥ 14 ॥
4.19.m: Seeing him unconscious, the serpents wept, overwhelmed with affection;

4.19.s:
kecitpalāyitā bhītāḥ kecitpraviviśurbilam ..
maraṇābhimukhaṃ kāntaṃ dṛṣṭvā sā surasā satī ..15..
4.19.d:
केचित्पलायिता भीताः केचित्प्रविविशुर्बिलम् ॥
मरणाभिमुखं कान्तं दृष्ट्वा सा सुरसा सती ॥15॥
4.19.m:
some fled in fear, while others entered their hole.
Seeing her beloved facing death, that virtuous Surasā,

4.19.s:
nāginībhiḥ saha premṇā ruroda purato hareḥ ..
puṭāñjaliyutā tūrṇaṃ praṇamya śrīhariṃ bhiyā..
dhṛtvā pādāravinde ca tamuvāca bhiyā''kulā .. 16 ..
4.19.d:
नागिनीभिः सह प्रेम्णा रुरोद पुरतो हरेः ॥
पुटाञ्जलियुता तूर्णं प्रणम्य श्रीहरिं भिया॥
धृत्वा पादारविन्दे च तमुवाच भिया'ऽकुला ॥ 16 ॥
4.19.m:
along with the serpent women, wept with love before Hari.
Quickly folding her hands and bowing down to Śrī Hari in fear,
holding his lotus feet, she spoke to him, agitated with fear:

4.19.s:
surasovāca .. ..
he jagatkānta me kāntaṃ dehi mānaṃ ca mānada ..
patiḥ prāṇādhikaḥ strīṇāṃ nāsti bandhuśca tatparaḥ .. 17 ..
4.19.d:
सुरसोवाच ॥ ॥
हे जगत्कान्त मे कान्तं देहि मानं च मानद ॥
पतिः प्राणाधिकः स्त्रीणां नास्ति बन्धुश्च तत्परः ॥ 17 ॥
4.19.m:
O Beloved of the universe, give me my beloved, and give me honor, O giver of honor!
A husband is dearer than life to women; there is no friend beyond him.

4.19.s:
sakalabhuvananātha prāṇanāthaṃ madīyaṃ na kuru vadhamananta premasindho subandho ..
akhilabhuvanabandho rādhikāpremasindho patimiha kuru dānaṃ me vidhāturvidhātaḥ .. 18 ..
4.19.d:
सकलभुवननाथ प्राणनाथं मदीयं न कुरु वधमनन्त प्रेमसिन्धो सुबन्धो ॥
अखिलभुवनबन्धो राधिकाप्रेमसिन्धो पतिमिह कुरु दानं मे विधातुर्विधातः ॥ 18 ॥
4.19.m:
O Lord of all the worlds, do not slay my life's lord, O endless one, ocean of love, good kinsman!
O friend of the entire universe, ocean of love for Rādhikā, grant me my husband here as a gift, O Creator of the Creator!

4.19.s:
trinayanavidhiśeṣāḥ ṣaṇmukhaścāsyasaṃghaiḥ stavanaviṣayajāḍyātstotumīśā na vāṇī..
khalu nikhilavedāḥstotumanye'pi devāḥ stavanaviṣayaśaktāḥ santi santastavaiva .. 19..
4.19.d:
त्रिनयनविधिशेषाः षण्मुखश्चास्यसंघैः स्तवनविषयजाड्यात्स्तोतुमीशा न वाणी॥
खलु निखिलवेदाःस्तोतुमन्येऽपि देवाः स्तवनविषयशक्ताः सन्ति सन्तस्तवैव ॥ 19॥
4.19.m:
The three-eyed one, Brahmā, and Śeṣa, and the six-faced one with their hosts of mouths are not able to praise [you], due to sluggishness in praising; nor is Speech;
how indeed can all the Vedas or other gods praise [you]? Only your own saintly devotees are capable of praising [you].

4.19.s:
kumatirahamadhijñā yoṣitāṃ kvādhamā vā kva bhuvanagatirīśaścakṣuṣo'gocarā'pi..
vidhihariharaśeṣaiḥ stūyamānaśca yastvamatanumanujamīśaṃ stotumicchāmi taṃ tvām .. .. 4.19.20 ..
4.19.d:
कुमतिरहमधिज्ञा योषितां क्वाधमा वा क्व भुवनगतिरीशश्चक्षुषोऽगोचराऽपि॥
विधिहरिहरशेषैः स्तूयमानश्च यस्त्वमतनुमनुजमीशं स्तोतुमिच्छामि तं त्वाम् ॥ ॥ 4.19.20 ॥
4.19.m:
Where am I, an evil-minded and ignorant one, the lowest of women, and where are you, the path of the universe, the Lord, beyond the range of sight?
You who are praised by Brahmā, Hari, Hara, and Śeṣa—I wish to praise you, that very Lord who has assumed the form of a small man!

4.19.s:
stavanaviṣayabhītā pārvatī kasya padmā śrutigaṇajanayitrī stotumīśā na yaṃ tvām ..
kalikaluṣanimagnā vedavedāṅgaśāstra śravaṇaviṣayamūḍhā stotumicchāmi kiṃ tvām..21..
4.19.d:
स्तवनविषयभीता पार्वती कस्य पद्मा श्रुतिगणजनयित्री स्तोतुमीशा न यं त्वाम् ॥
कलिकलुषनिमग्ना वेदवेदाङ्गशास्त्र श्रवणविषयमूढा स्तोतुमिच्छामि किं त्वाम्॥21॥
4.19.m:
Pārvatī, fearful of praising, and Padmā—whose mother of the host of Vedas is not able to praise you—
how can I, plunged into the defilements of the Kali age and foolish regarding the hearing of the Vedas, the Vedāṅgas, and the Śāstras, wish to praise you?

4.19.s:
śayāno ratnaparyaṅke ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ ..
ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣāṅgo rādhāvakṣasi saṃsthitaḥ.. .. 22 ..
4.19.d:
शयानो रत्नपर्यङ्के रत्नभूषणभूषितः ॥
रत्नभूषणभूषाङ्गो राधावक्षसि संस्थितः॥ ॥ 22 ॥
4.19.m:
Reclining on a jewel couch, adorned with jewel ornaments,
his limbs decorated with jewel ornaments, resting upon the breast of Rādhā,

4.19.s:
candanokṣitasarvāṅgaḥ smerānanasaroruhaḥ ..
prodyatpremarasāmbhodhau nimagnaḥ satataṃ sukhāt ..23 ..
4.19.d:
चन्दनोक्षितसर्वाङ्गः स्मेराननसरोरुहः ॥
प्रोद्यत्प्रेमरसाम्भोधौ निमग्नः सततं सुखात् ॥23 ॥
4.19.m:
all his limbs anointed with sandalwood paste, his lotus face smiling—
immersed constantly and blissfully in the rising ocean of the nectar of love;

4.19.s:
mallikāmālatīmālājālaiḥ śobhitaśekharaḥ ..
pārijātaprasūnānāṃ gandhāmoditamānasaḥ .. 24 ..
4.19.d:
मल्लिकामालतीमालाजालैः शोभितशेखरः ॥
पारिजातप्रसूनानां गन्धामोदितमानसः ॥ 24 ॥
4.19.m:
whose crown is adorned with garlands of mallikā and mālatī blossoms;
whose mind is delighted by the fragrance of pārijāta flowers;

4.19.s:
puṃskokilakaladhvānairbhramaradhvanisaṃyutaiḥ ..
kusumeṣu vikāreṇa pulakāṅkitavigrahaḥ ..25..
4.19.d:
पुंस्कोकिलकलध्वानैर्भ्रमरध्वनिसंयुतैः ॥
कुसुमेषु विकारेण पुलकाङ्कितविग्रहः ॥25॥
4.19.m:
whose body bristles with horripilation aroused by the god of love,
at the melodious songs of male cuckoos mingling with the humming of bees;

4.19.s:
priyāpradattatāmbūlaṃ bhuktavānyaḥ sadā mudā ..
vedā aśaktā yaṃ stotuṃ jaḍībhūtā vicakṣaṇāḥ .. 26..
4.19.d:
प्रियाप्रदत्तताम्बूलं भुक्तवान्यः सदा मुदा ॥
वेदा अशक्ता यं स्तोतुं जडीभूता विचक्षणाः ॥ 26॥
4.19.m:
who always joyfully chews the betel offered by his beloved;
whom the Vedas are unable to praise, and before whom the wise become dumb—

4.19.s:
tamanirvacanīyaṃ ca kiṃ staumi nāgavallabhā ..
vande'haṃ tvatpadāmbhojaṃ brahmeśaśeṣasevitam ..27..
4.19.d:
तमनिर्वचनीयं च किं स्तौमि नागवल्लभा ॥
वन्देऽहं त्वत्पदाम्भोजं ब्रह्मेशशेषसेवितम् ॥27॥
4.19.m:
how can I, the beloved of a serpent, praise that ineffable one?
I salute your lotus feet, served by Brahmā, Śiva, and Śeṣa,

4.19.s:
lakṣmīsarasvatīdurgā jāhnavī vedamātṛbhiḥ ..
sevitaṃ siddhasaṃghaiśca munīndrairmanubhiḥ sadā ..28..
4.19.d:
लक्ष्मीसरस्वतीदुर्गा जाह्नवी वेदमातृभिः ॥
सेवितं सिद्धसंघैश्च मुनीन्द्रैर्मनुभिः सदा ॥28॥
4.19.m:
and served by Lakṣmī, Sarasvatī, Durgā, the Jāhnavī, and the Mothers of the Vedas,
as well as constantly by hosts of siddhas, lords of sages, and Manus!

4.19.s:
niṣkāraṇāyākhilakāraṇāya sarveśvarāyāpi parātparāya ..
svayaṃprakāśāya parāvarāya parāvarāṇāmadhipāya te namaḥ .. 29 ..
4.19.d:
निष्कारणायाखिलकारणाय सर्वेश्वरायापि परात्पराय ॥
स्वयंप्रकाशाय परावराय परावराणामधिपाय ते नमः ॥ 29 ॥
4.19.m:
Homage to you, who are uncaused, the cause of all, the Lord of all, and higher than the highest,
self-luminous, higher and lower, and the ruler of both the higher and the lower!

4.19.s:
he kṛṣṇa he kṛṣṇa surāsureśa brahmeśa śeṣeśa prajāpatīśa..
munīśa manvīśa carācareśa siddhīśa siddheśa gaṇeśa pāhi..4.19.30..
4.19.d:
हे कृष्ण हे कृष्ण सुरासुरेश ब्रह्मेश शेषेश प्रजापतीश॥
मुनीश मन्वीश चराचरेश सिद्धीश सिद्धेश गणेश पाहि॥4.19.30॥
4.19.m:
O Kṛṣṇa, O Kṛṣṇa, Lord of gods and asuras, Lord of Brahmā, Śiva, Śeṣa, and the Prajāpatis!
Lord of sages, Lord of Manus, Lord of the moving and unmoving, Lord of siddhis, Lord of siddhas, Lord of Gaṇas, protect us!

4.19.s:
dharmeśa dharmīśa śubhāśubheśa vedeśa vedeṣvanirūpitaśca..
sarveśa sarvātmaka sarvabandho jīvīśa jīveśvara pāhi matprabhum .. 31 ..
4.19.d:
धर्मेश धर्मीश शुभाशुभेश वेदेश वेदेष्वनिरूपितश्च॥
सर्वेश सर्वात्मक सर्वबन्धो जीवीश जीवेश्वर पाहि मत्प्रभुम् ॥ 31 ॥
4.19.m:
Lord of righteousness, Lord of the righteous, Lord of good and evil, Lord of the Vedas, yet undefinable in the Vedas!
Lord of all, Soul of all, Friend of all, Lord of living beings, Ruler of life, protect my lord!

4.19.s:
ityevaṃ stavanaṃ kṛtvā bhaktinamrātmakandharā ..
vidhṛtya caraṇāmbhojaṃ tasthau nāgeśavallabhā .. 32 ..
4.19.d:
इत्येवं स्तवनं कृत्वा भक्तिनम्रात्मकन्धरा ॥
विधृत्य चरणाम्भोजं तस्थौ नागेशवल्लभा ॥ 32 ॥
4.19.m:
Having thus sung a hymn of praise, her neck bowed in devotion,
clasping his lotus feet, the beloved of the serpent lord stood there.

4.19.s:
nāgapatnīkṛtaṃ stotraṃ trisandhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhennaraḥ ..
sarvapāpātpramuktastu yātyante śrīhareḥ padam..33..
4.19.d:
नागपत्नीकृतं स्तोत्रं त्रिसन्ध्यं यः पठेन्नरः ॥
सर्वपापात्प्रमुक्तस्तु यात्यन्ते श्रीहरेः पदम्॥33॥
4.19.m:
Whatever man recites at the three junctures of the day this hymn composed by the serpent’s wife,
freed from all sins, goes in the end to the abode of holy Hari.

4.19.s:
iha loke harerbhaktimante dāsyaṃ labheddhruvam ..
labhate pārṣado bhūtvā sālokyādicatuṣṭayam .. 34 ..
4.19.d:
इह लोके हरेर्भक्तिमन्ते दास्यं लभेद्ध्रुवम् ॥
लभते पार्षदो भूत्वा सालोक्यादिचतुष्टयम् ॥ 34 ॥
4.19.m: becoming an attendant, he attains the fourfold [liberation] beginning with sālokya.

4.19.s:
nārada uvāca ..
nāgapatnīvacaḥ śrutvā bhagavānsarvanandanaḥ ..
prahṛṣṭotphullanayanaḥ kimuvāca hariḥ svayam .. 39 ..
4.19.d:
नारद उवाच ॥
नागपत्नीवचः श्रुत्वा भगवान्सर्वनन्दनः ॥
प्रहृष्टोत्फुल्लनयनः किमुवाच हरिः स्वयम् ॥ 39 ॥
4.19.m:
Having heard the words of the serpent’s wife, what did the Lord, the delighter of all,
Hari himself, say, his eyes blooming with joy?

4.19.s:
kathayasva mahābhāga rahasyaṃ paramādbhutam ..
sūta uvāca ..
nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā bhagavānsarvadarśanaḥ .. 36 ..
4.19.d:
कथयस्व महाभाग रहस्यं परमाद्भुतम् ॥
सूत उवाच ॥
नारदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा भगवान्सर्वदर्शनः ॥ 36 ॥
4.19.m:
Tell [me], O fortunate one, this supreme and wonderful secret!
Hearing Nārada’s words, the all-seeing Lord

4.19.s:
uvāca paramātmānaṃ madhuvṛndaṃ padepade ..
nārāyaṇa uvāca ..
nāgapatnīvacaḥ śrutvā śrīkṛṣṇastamuvāca ha .. 37 ..
4.19.d:
उवाच परमात्मानं मधुवृन्दं पदेपदे ॥
नारायण उवाच ॥
नागपत्नीवचः श्रुत्वा श्रीकृष्णस्तमुवाच ह ॥ 37 ॥
4.19.m:
spoke of the Paramātman, a sweet collection [of words] at every step.
Having heard the words of the serpent’s wife, Lord Kṛṣṇa indeed spoke to her,

4.19.s:
puṭāñjaliyutāṃ pāde patitāṃ bhayavihvalām ..
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ..
uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha nāgeśe varaṃ vṛṇu bhayaṃ tyaja .. 38 ..
4.19.d:
पुटाञ्जलियुतां पादे पतितां भयविह्वलाम् ॥
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥
उत्तिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ नागेशे वरं वृणु भयं त्यज ॥ 38 ॥
4.19.m:
as she folded her hands, fallen at his feet and overwhelmed with fear.
Arise, arise, O serpent queen! Choose a boon and cast away fear.

4.19.s:
gṛhāṇa kāntaṃ he mātarmadvarādajarāmaram ..
kālindīhradamutsṛjya svakīyaṃ bhavanaṃ vraja ..39..
4.19.d:
गृहाण कान्तं हे मातर्मद्वरादजरामरम् ॥
कालिन्दीह्रदमुत्सृज्य स्वकीयं भवनं व्रज ॥39॥
4.19.m:
Take your husband, O mother, free from old age and death by my boon!
Abandoning the pool of the Kālindī, go to your own dwelling.

4.19.s:
bhartrā sagoṣṭhyā sārddhaṃ ca gaccha vatse sukhī bhava ..
adya prabhṛti nāgeśi bhūtā kanyā ca tvaṃ mama .. 4.19.40 ..
4.19.d:
भर्त्रा सगोष्ठ्या सार्द्धं च गच्छ वत्से सुखी भव ॥
अद्य प्रभृति नागेशि भूता कन्या च त्वं मम ॥ 4.19.40 ॥
4.19.m:
Go with your husband and your retinue, my child, and be happy!
From this day forth, O serpent queen, you have become my daughter,

4.19.s:
tvatprāṇādhika evāyaṃ jāmātā ca na saṃśayaḥ ..
matpādapadmacihnena garuḍastvatpatiṃ śubhe .. 41 ..
4.19.d:
त्वत्प्राणाधिक एवायं जामाता च न संशयः ॥
मत्पादपद्मचिह्नेन गरुडस्त्वत्पतिं शुभे ॥ 41 ॥
4.19.m:
and this [husband of yours] is undoubtedly my son-in-law, dearer than life itself.
Because of the mark of my lotus foot, O auspicious one, Garuḍa,

4.19.s:
kṛtvā ca stavanaṃ bhaktyā praṇamiṣyati matpadam ..
tyaja tvaṃ garuḍādbhītiṃ śīghraṃ ramaṇakaṃ vraja..42..
4.19.d:
कृत्वा च स्तवनं भक्त्या प्रणमिष्यति मत्पदम् ॥
त्यज त्वं गरुडाद्भीतिं शीघ्रं रमणकं व्रज॥42॥
4.19.m:
having offered praise with devotion, will bow to my footstep on your husband.
Cast away your fear of Garuḍa and go swiftly to Ramaṇaka!

4.19.s:
hradānnirgaccha vatse tvaṃ varaṃ vṛṇu yathepsitam ..
śrīkṛṣṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā prasannavadanekṣaṇā .. 43 ..
4.19.d:
ह्रदान्निर्गच्छ वत्से त्वं वरं वृणु यथेप्सितम् ॥
श्रीकृष्णस्य वचः श्रुत्वा प्रसन्नवदनेक्षणा ॥ 43 ॥
4.19.m:
Come out from the pool, my child, and choose whatever boon you desire!
Hearing Lord Kṛṣṇa's words, her face and eyes bright with joy,

4.19.s:
uvāca sāśrunetrā sā bhaktinamrātmakandharā ..
surasovāca .. varaṃ dāsyasi cedānīṃ varadeśvara me'pi ca .. 44 ..
4.19.d:
उवाच साश्रुनेत्रा सा भक्तिनम्रात्मकन्धरा ॥
सुरसोवाच ॥ वरं दास्यसि चेदानीं वरदेश्वर मेऽपि च ॥ 44 ॥
4.19.m:
she spoke with tears in her eyes, her neck bowed in devotion.
Surasā said: / If you will grant a boon to me now, O Lord of boon-givers,

4.19.s:
tvatpādābje dṛḍhāṃ bhaktiṃ niścalāṃ dātumarhasi ..
manmanastvatpadātmbhoje bhramatu bhramaro yathā .. 42..
4.19.d:
त्वत्पादाब्जे दृढां भक्तिं निश्चलां दातुमर्हसि ॥
मन्मनस्त्वत्पदात्म्भोजे भ्रमतु भ्रमरो यथा ॥ 42॥
4.19.m:
you should grant firm, unwavering devotion to your lotus feet!
May my mind hover at your lotus feet like a bee;

4.19.s:
tava smṛtarvismṛtirna kadā'pi na bhaviṣyati ..
svakānte mama saubhāgyaṃ kānto'yaṃ jñānināṃ varaḥ ..46..
4.19.d:
तव स्मृतर्विस्मृतिर्न कदाऽपि न भविष्यति ॥
स्वकान्ते मम सौभाग्यं कान्तोऽयं ज्ञानिनां वरः ॥46॥
4.19.m:
may remembrance of you never, ever be forgotten!
May I have good fortune with my beloved husband, and may this husband be the best of the wise!

4.19.s:
ityevaṃ prārthanīyaṃ ca paripūrṇaṃ kuru prabho ..
ityevamuktvā sarpastrī pratasthau purato hareḥ ..47..
4.19.d:
इत्येवं प्रार्थनीयं च परिपूर्णं कुरु प्रभो ॥
इत्येवमुक्त्वा सर्पस्त्री प्रतस्थौ पुरतो हरेः ॥47॥
4.19.m:
O Lord, fulfill this prayer of mine!
Having spoken thus, the serpent wife stood before Hari.

4.19.s:
śaratpārvaṇacandrāsyaṃ dadarśa śrīharermukham..
locanābhyāṃ papau vaktraṃ nimeṣarahitaṃ satī .. 48 ..
4.19.d:
शरत्पार्वणचन्द्रास्यं ददर्श श्रीहरेर्मुखम्॥
लोचनाभ्यां पपौ वक्त्रं निमेषरहितं सती ॥ 48 ॥
4.19.m:
She looked upon the face of holy Hari, which was like the full autumn moon;
the chaste woman drank in his face with her eyes, without blinking.

4.19.s:
sarvāṅgapulakodbhinnā sānaṃdāśrupariplutā ..
sundaraṃ bālakaṃ dṛṣṭvā putrasnehaṃ prakurvatī.. .. 49 ..
4.19.d:
सर्वाङ्गपुलकोद्भिन्ना सानंदाश्रुपरिप्लुता ॥
सुन्दरं बालकं दृष्ट्वा पुत्रस्नेहं प्रकुर्वती॥ ॥ 49 ॥
4.19.m:
Her whole body bristling with horripilation, overflowing with tears of joy,
seeing the beautiful boy, feeling maternal love for him as a son,

4.19.s:
uvāca punarevedaṃ bhaktyudrekapariplutā ..
na yāsyāmi ramaṇakaṃ tatra nāsti prayojanam .. 4.19.50 ..
4.19.d:
उवाच पुनरेवेदं भक्त्युद्रेकपरिप्लुता ॥
न यास्यामि रमणकं तत्र नास्ति प्रयोजनम् ॥ 4.19.50 ॥
4.19.m:
overwhelmed by a surge of devotion, she spoke yet again:
“I will not go to Ramaṇaka; there is no purpose there.

4.19.s:
sarpaḥ karotu saṃsāraṃ kuru māṃ nijakiṅkarīm ..
na vāñchā mama he kṛṣṇa sālokyādicatuṣṭaye ..51..
4.19.d:
सर्पः करोतु संसारं कुरु मां निजकिङ्करीम् ॥
न वाञ्छा मम हे कृष्ण सालोक्यादिचतुष्टये ॥51॥
4.19.m:
Let the serpent lead worldly life; make me your own servant!”
I have no desire, O Kṛṣṇa, for the four [liberations] beginning with Sālokya;

4.19.s:
tvatpadāmbhojasevāyāḥ kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ..
vinā tvatpādasevāṃ ca yo vāñchati varāntaram..52..
4.19.d:
त्वत्पदाम्भोजसेवायाः कलां नार्हन्ति षोडशीम् ॥
विना त्वत्पादसेवां च यो वाञ्छति वरान्तरम्॥52॥
4.19.m:
they are not worth a sixteenth part of service to your lotus feet.
And whoever desires another boon without service to your feet,

4.19.s:
bhārate durlabhaṃ janma labdhvā'sau vañcitaḥ svayam..
nāgapatnyā vacaḥ śrutvā smerānanasaroruhaḥ..53..
4.19.d:
भारते दुर्लभं जन्म लब्ध्वाऽसौ वञ्चितः स्वयम्॥
नागपत्न्या वचः श्रुत्वा स्मेराननसरोरुहः॥53॥
4.19.m:
having attained a rare birth in Bhārata, deceives himself."
Hearing the serpent’s wife's words, his lotus face smiling,

4.19.s:
prasannamānasaḥ śrīmānomityevamuvāca ha ..
etasminnaṃtare divyaḥ sadratnasāranirmitaḥ .. 54 ..
4.19.d:
प्रसन्नमानसः श्रीमानोमित्येवमुवाच ह ॥
एतस्मिन्नंतरे दिव्यः सद्रत्नसारनिर्मितः ॥ 54 ॥
4.19.m:
pleased in mind, the glorious lord said: "So be it!"
At that moment, a divine chariot fashioned from the essence of excellent gems,

4.19.s:
ājagāma rathastūrṇamuddīptastejasā mune ..
pārṣadapravarairyukto vastramālāparicchadaḥ .. 55 ..
4.19.d:
आजगाम रथस्तूर्णमुद्दीप्तस्तेजसा मुने ॥
पार्षदप्रवरैर्युक्तो वस्त्रमालापरिच्छदः ॥ 55 ॥
4.19.m:
blazing with splendour, quickly arrived, O sage,
accompanied by foremost attendants, furnished with garments and garlands,

4.19.s:
śatacakro vāyuvego manoyāyī manoharaḥ ..
avaruhya rathāttūrṇaṃ śyāmalāḥ śyāma kiṅkarāḥ ..56..
4.19.d:
शतचक्रो वायुवेगो मनोयायी मनोहरः ॥
अवरुह्य रथात्तूर्णं श्यामलाः श्याम किङ्कराः ॥56॥
4.19.m:
with a hundred wheels, swift as the wind, moving at the speed of thought, captivating.
Quickly descending from the chariot, the dark-complexioned servants of the Dark One,

4.19.s:
praṇamya kṛṣṇaṃ tāṃ nītvā jagmurgolokamuttamam ..
hariśchāyāṃ vinirmāya dadau sarpāya tejasā ..97 ..
4.19.d:
प्रणम्य कृष्णं तां नीत्वा जग्मुर्गोलोकमुत्तमम् ॥
हरिश्छायां विनिर्माय ददौ सर्पाय तेजसा ॥97 ॥
4.19.m:
having bowed to Kṛṣṇa and taken her, went to supreme Goloka.
Hari, creating an illusory shadow through his splendour, gave it to the serpent;

4.19.s:
sa ca kiṃcinna bubudhe mohito viṣṇumāyayā..
avaruhya sarpamūrdhnaḥ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ karuṇānidhiḥ..58..
4.19.d:
स च किंचिन्न बुबुधे मोहितो विष्णुमायया॥
अवरुह्य सर्पमूर्ध्नः श्रीकृष्णः करुणानिधिः॥58॥
4.19.m:
and he, deluded by Viṣṇu's māyā, perceived nothing at all.
Descending from the serpent's head, Śrī Kṛṣṇa, an ocean of compassion,

4.19.s:
dadau hastaṃ ca kṛpayā śīghraṃ kāliyamastake ..
saṃprāpya cetanāṃ sadyo dadarśa purato harim..59..
4.19.d:
ददौ हस्तं च कृपया शीघ्रं कालियमस्तके ॥
संप्राप्य चेतनां सद्यो ददर्श पुरतो हरिम्॥59॥
4.19.m:
compassionately placed his hand quickly upon Kāliya's head.
Instantly regaining consciousness, he saw Hari before him,

4.19.s:
puṭāñjaliyutāṃ sāśrupūrṇāṃ ca surasāṃ satīm ..
praṇanāma hariṃ sadyo ruroda premavihvalaḥ ..4.19.60 ..
4.19.d:
पुटाञ्जलियुतां साश्रुपूर्णां च सुरसां सतीम् ॥
प्रणनाम हरिं सद्यो रुरोद प्रेमविह्वलः ॥4.19.60 ॥
4.19.m:
and the virtuous Surasā, with folded palms, filled with tears.
He bowed down at once to Hari and wept, overcome with love.

4.19.s:
bhaktyudrekātsāśrunetrāṃ pulakāṅkitavigrahām ..
tūṣṇīṃbhūtāṃ ca tāṃ dṛṣṭvā samuvāca kṛpānidhiḥ ..
yadīśvarasya satataṃ yogyāyogye samā kṛpā ..61..
4.19.d:
भक्त्युद्रेकात्साश्रुनेत्रां पुलकाङ्कितविग्रहाम् ॥
तूष्णींभूतां च तां दृष्ट्वा समुवाच कृपानिधिः ॥
यदीश्वरस्य सततं योग्यायोग्ये समा कृपा ॥61॥
4.19.m:
Seeing her with tearful eyes from the surge of devotion, her body covered in goosebumps,
and remaining silent, the ocean of mercy addressed [him],
since the Lord's compassion is always equal toward the worthy and the unworthy.

4.19.s:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ..
varaṃ vṛṇu tvaṃ kālīya yaste manasi vartate ..62..
4.19.d:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥
वरं वृणु त्वं कालीय यस्ते मनसि वर्तते ॥62॥
4.19.m: "Choose a boon, O Kāliya, whatever is in your heart;

4.19.s:
tvaṃ me prāṇādhiko vatsa sukhaṃ tiṣṭha bhayaṃ tyaja ..
tasyāhamanugṛhṇāṇi yo'tibhakto mamāṃśajaḥ ..63..
4.19.d:
त्वं मे प्राणाधिको वत्स सुखं तिष्ठ भयं त्यज ॥
तस्याहमनुगृह्णाणि योऽतिभक्तो ममांशजः ॥63॥
4.19.m:
you are dearer to me than life, my child; abide in happiness, cast away fear.
I bestow favour upon him who is exceedingly devoted, born of my portion;

4.19.s:
kiṃcittaddamanaṃ kṛtvā tvatprasādaṃ karomyaham ..
tvadvaṃśajātānsarpāṃśca hanti yo mānavādhamaḥ .. 64..
4.19.d:
किंचित्तद्दमनं कृत्वा त्वत्प्रसादं करोम्यहम् ॥
त्वद्वंशजातान्सर्पांश्च हन्ति यो मानवाधमः ॥ 64॥
4.19.m:
having subdued you a little, I show you grace.
And whatever base human kills serpents born of your lineage,

4.19.s:
brahmahatyāsamaṃ pāpaṃ bhavitā tasya niścitam ..
matpādapadmacihne yaḥ karoti daṇḍatāḍanam ..55..
4.19.d:
ब्रह्महत्यासमं पापं भविता तस्य निश्चितम् ॥
मत्पादपद्मचिह्ने यः करोति दण्डताडनम् ॥55॥
4.19.m:
his sin shall certainly be equal to the murder of a brahmin.
He who strikes with a stick the mark of my lotus feet,

4.19.s:
dviguṇaṃ brahmahatyāyā bhavitā tasya kilbiṣam..
lakṣmīryāsyati tadgehācchāpaṃ dattvā sudāruṇam ..66..
4.19.d:
द्विगुणं ब्रह्महत्याया भविता तस्य किल्बिषम्॥
लक्ष्मीर्यास्यति तद्गेहाच्छापं दत्त्वा सुदारुणम् ॥66॥
4.19.m:
his guilt shall be twice that of killing a brahmin.
Lakṣmī shall depart from his house, uttering a terrible curse;

4.19.s:
vaṃśāyuryaśasā hānirbhavitā tasya niścitam ..
dhruvaṃ varṣaśataṃ kālasūtre yāsyati madgirā ..67..
4.19.d:
वंशायुर्यशसा हानिर्भविता तस्य निश्चितम् ॥
ध्रुवं वर्षशतं कालसूत्रे यास्यति मद्गिरा ॥67॥
4.19.m:
the loss of his lineage, life-span, and fame shall surely occur.
By my word, he shall surely go to Kālasūtra for a hundred years;

4.19.s:
tvatpramāṇāḥ kīṭasaṃghā daṃśiṣyanti ca saṃtatam ..
bhogānte janma labdhvā ca tanmṛtyustasya daṃśanāt .. 68 ..
4.19.d:
त्वत्प्रमाणाः कीटसंघा दंशिष्यन्ति च संततम् ॥
भोगान्ते जन्म लब्ध्वा च तन्मृत्युस्तस्य दंशनात् ॥ 68 ॥
4.19.m:
swarms of worms of your size will continually bite [him].
And when his punishment is over, having obtained birth, his death shall come from your bite,

4.19.s:
tasya vaṃśodbhavānāṃ ca tvadvaṃśādbhavitā bhayam ..
ye ca tvadvaṃśajāndṛṣṭvā supadāṅkaṃ madīyakam .. 69 ..
4.19.d:
तस्य वंशोद्भवानां च त्वद्वंशाद्भविता भयम् ॥
ये च त्वद्वंशजान्दृष्ट्वा सुपदाङ्कं मदीयकम् ॥ 69 ॥
4.19.m:
and there shall be fear from your lineage for those born of his lineage.
And those who, seeing the descendants of your lineage [bearing] the auspicious mark of my feet,

4.19.s:
praṇamiṣyanti bhaktyā te mucyante sarvapātakāt ..
gaccha śīghraṃ ramaṇakaṃ tyaja bhītiṃ khagādhipāt ..4.19.70..
4.19.d:
प्रणमिष्यन्ति भक्त्या ते मुच्यन्ते सर्वपातकात् ॥
गच्छ शीघ्रं रमणकं त्यज भीतिं खगाधिपात् ॥4.19.70॥
4.19.m:
bow down with devotion, are freed from all sins.
Go quickly to Ramaṇaka; abandon fear of the king of birds;

4.19.s:
matpadāṅkaṃ mūrdhni dṛṣṭvā tvāṃ bhaktyā praṇamiṣyati ..
tava tvadvaṃśajānāṃ ca garuḍānna bhayaṃ kvacit ..71..
4.19.d:
मत्पदाङ्कं मूर्ध्नि दृष्ट्वा त्वां भक्त्या प्रणमिष्यति ॥
तव त्वद्वंशजानां च गरुडान्न भयं क्वचित् ॥71॥
4.19.m:
seeing the mark of my feet upon your head, he will bow to you with devotion.
There is never any fear from Garuḍa for you and those born of your lineage;

4.19.s:
sarveṣāṃ jñātisarpāṇāṃ varo'dya bhava madvarāt ..
varaṃ kiṃ paramaṃ vatsa vāñchitaṃ varayādhunā .. 72 ..
4.19.d:
सर्वेषां ज्ञातिसर्पाणां वरोऽद्य भव मद्वरात् ॥
वरं किं परमं वत्स वाञ्छितं वरयाधुना ॥ 72 ॥
4.19.m:
become today the foremost of all kinsmen serpents by my boon.
What supreme boon is desired, my child? Choose it now;

4.19.s:
bhayaṃ tyaktvā kathaya māṃ tvadīyaṃ duḥkhabhañjanam ..
śrīkṛṣṇavacanaṃ śrutvā kāliyaḥ kampito bhiyā ..
puṭāñjaliyuto bhūtvā tamuvāca bhujaṅgamaḥ .. 73 ..
4.19.d:
भयं त्यक्त्वा कथय मां त्वदीयं दुःखभञ्जनम् ॥
श्रीकृष्णवचनं श्रुत्वा कालियः कम्पितो भिया ॥
पुटाञ्जलियुतो भूत्वा तमुवाच भुजङ्गमः ॥ 73 ॥
4.19.m:
abandoning fear, tell me, the dispeller of your sorrow."
Hearing Śrī Kṛṣṇa's words, Kāliya, trembling with fear,
joined his palms and spoke to him, the serpent:

4.19.s:
kāliya uvāca ..
vare'nyasminmama vibho vāñchā nāsti varaprada .. .. 74 ..
4.19.d:
कालिय उवाच ॥
वरेऽन्यस्मिन्मम विभो वाञ्छा नास्ति वरप्रद ॥ ॥ 74 ॥
4.19.m: "I have no desire for any other boon, O all-pervading Lord, O giver of boons;

4.19.s:
bhaktiṃ smṛtiṃ tvatpadābje dehi janmani janmani ..
janma brahmakule vā'pi tiryagyoniṣu vā samam .. 75 ..
4.19.d:
भक्तिं स्मृतिं त्वत्पदाब्जे देहि जन्मनि जन्मनि ॥
जन्म ब्रह्मकुले वाऽपि तिर्यग्योनिषु वा समम् ॥ 75 ॥
4.19.m:
grant me devotion and remembrance of your lotus feet in birth after birth.
Birth in a brahmin family or in animal wombs is the same;

4.19.s:
tadbhavetsaphalaṃ yatra smṛtistvaccaraṇāmbuje ..
tanniṣphalaḥ svargavāso nāsti cettvatpadasmṛtiḥ .. 76 ..
4.19.d:
तद्भवेत्सफलं यत्र स्मृतिस्त्वच्चरणाम्बुजे ॥
तन्निष्फलः स्वर्गवासो नास्ति चेत्त्वत्पदस्मृतिः ॥ 76 ॥
4.19.m:
it becomes fruitful where there is remembrance of your lotus feet.
Living in heaven is fruitless if there is no remembrance of your feet;

4.19.s:
tvatpādadhyānayuktasya yattatsthānaṃ ca tatparam ..
kṣaṇaṃ vā koṭikalpaṃ vā puruṣāyuḥ kṣayo'stu vā .. 77 ..
4.19.d:
त्वत्पादध्यानयुक्तस्य यत्तत्स्थानं च तत्परम् ॥
क्षणं वा कोटिकल्पं वा पुरुषायुः क्षयोऽस्तु वा ॥ 77 ॥
4.19.m:
for one engaged in meditation on your feet, whatever place that is, is supreme.
Whether for a moment or for ten million kalpas, let a man's life-span be spent;

4.19.s:
yadi tvatsevayā yāti saphalo niṣkalo'thavā ..
teṣāṃ cāyurvyayo nāsti ye tvatpādābjasevakāḥ..78..
4.19.d:
यदि त्वत्सेवया याति सफलो निष्कलोऽथवा ॥
तेषां चायुर्व्ययो नास्ति ये त्वत्पादाब्जसेवकाः॥78॥
4.19.m:
if it passes in your service, it is fruitful, whether [otherwise] complete or defective.
And there is no loss of life for those who are servants of your lotus feet;

4.19.s:
na santi janmamaraṇarogaśokārtibhītayaḥ ..
indratve vā'maratve vā brahmatve cātidurlabhe..79..
4.19.d:
न सन्ति जन्ममरणरोगशोकार्तिभीतयः ॥
इन्द्रत्वे वाऽमरत्वे वा ब्रह्मत्वे चातिदुर्लभे॥79॥
4.19.m:
for them there are no fears of birth, death, disease, grief, and affliction.
Neither in Indra's state, nor in immortality, nor in Brahmā's state, exceedingly hard to attain,

4.19.s:
vāñchā nāstyeva bhaktānāṃ tvatpādasevanaṃ vinā ..
sujīrṇapaṭakhaṇḍasya samaṃ nūtanameva ca .. 4.19.80 ..
4.19.d:
वाञ्छा नास्त्येव भक्तानां त्वत्पादसेवनं विना ॥
सुजीर्णपटखण्डस्य समं नूतनमेव च ॥ 4.19.80 ॥
4.19.m:
is there any desire for devotees, except for service to your feet.
Devotees regard [such boons] as equal to a piece of worn-out cloth, and new cloth likewise;

4.19.s:
paśyanti bhaktāḥ kiṃ cānyatsālokyādicatuṣṭayam ..
saṃprāptastvanmanurbrahmannanaṃtādyāvadeva hi ..81..
4.19.d:
पश्यन्ति भक्ताः किं चान्यत्सालोक्यादिचतुष्टयम् ॥
संप्राप्तस्त्वन्मनुर्ब्रह्मन्ननंताद्यावदेव हि ॥81॥
4.19.m:
and what else of the fourfold [liberation], beginning with sälokya?
O Brahman, from the time your mantra was received from Ananta onwards,

4.19.s:
tāvattvadbhāvanenaiva tvadvarṇo'hamanugrahāt ..
māṃ ca bhaktamapakvaṃ vā vijñāya garuḍaḥ svayam .. .. 82 ..
4.19.d:
तावत्त्वद्भावनेनैव त्वद्वर्णोऽहमनुग्रहात् ॥
मां च भक्तमपक्वं वा विज्ञाय गरुडः स्वयम् ॥ ॥ 82 ॥
4.19.m:
by meditation upon you alone I came to bear your hue through your grace.
Garuḍa himself, recognizing me to be an unripened devotee,

4.19.s:
deśād dūraṃ ca nyakkāraṃ cakāra dṛḍhabhaktimān ..
bhavatā ca dṛḍhāṃ bhaktiṃ dattvā me varadeśvara ..83..
4.19.d:
देशाद् दूरं च न्यक्कारं चकार दृढभक्तिमान् ॥
भवता च दृढां भक्तिं दत्त्वा मे वरदेश्वर ॥83॥
4.19.m:
cast me down afar from the land, endowed as he is with firm devotion.
And since firm devotion has been bestowed upon me by you, O Lord who bestows boons,

4.19.s:
sa ca uktaśca bhakto'haṃ na māṃ tyaktuṃ kṣamo'dhunā ..
tvatpādapadmacihnāktaṃ dṛṣṭvā śrīmastakaṃ mama ..84..
4.19.d:
स च उक्तश्च भक्तोऽहं न मां त्यक्तुं क्षमोऽधुना ॥
त्वत्पादपद्मचिह्नाक्तं दृष्ट्वा श्रीमस्तकं मम ॥84॥
4.19.m:
and it was said that I am a devotee, he is not able to abandon me now.
Having seen my glorious head marked with the sign of your lotus feet,

4.19.s:
sadoṣaṃ guṇayuktaṃ māṃ so'dhunā tyaktumakṣamaḥ ..
mamārādhyāśca nāgeṃdrā na tadvadhyo'hamīśvara .. 85 ..
4.19.d:
सदोषं गुणयुक्तं मां सोऽधुना त्यक्तुमक्षमः ॥
ममाराध्याश्च नागेंद्रा न तद्वध्योऽहमीश्वर ॥ 85 ॥
4.19.m:
he is now unable to abandon me, faulty though I am, endowed with virtue.
The serpent lords are also my objects of worship, and I am not to be slain by him, O Lord.

4.19.s:
bhayaṃ na kebhyaḥ sarvatra tamanaṃtaṃ guruṃ vinā ..
yaṃ devendrāśca devāśca munayo manavo narāḥ .. 86 ..
4.19.d:
भयं न केभ्यः सर्वत्र तमनंतं गुरुं विना ॥
यं देवेन्द्राश्च देवाश्च मुनयो मनवो नराः ॥ 86 ॥
4.19.m:
From whom is there not fear everywhere, except from that guru Ananta?
He whom the lords of gods, the gods, the sages, Manus, and men

4.19.s:
svapne dhyānena paśyaṃti cakṣuṣorgocaraḥ sa me ..
bhaktānurodhātsākāraḥ kutaste vigraho vibho .. 87 ..
4.19.d:
स्वप्ने ध्यानेन पश्यंति चक्षुषोर्गोचरः स मे ॥
भक्तानुरोधात्साकारः कुतस्ते विग्रहो विभो ॥ 87 ॥
4.19.m:
behold in a dream through meditation has come within the range of my eyes.
Out of regard for devotees you are with form; whence otherwise your physical form, O all-pervading one?

4.19.s:
saguṇatvaṃ ca sākāro nirākāraśca nirguṇaḥ ..
svecchāmayaḥ sarvadhāma sarvabījaṃ sanātanam .. 88 ..
4.19.d:
सगुणत्वं च साकारो निराकारश्च निर्गुणः ॥
स्वेच्छामयः सर्वधाम सर्वबीजं सनातनम् ॥ 88 ॥
4.19.m:
You possess gunas and you are with form; you are formless and devoid of gunas.
You act according to your own will, the dwelling-place of all, the eternal seed of all,

4.19.s:
sarveṣāmīśvaraḥ sākṣī sarvātmā sarvarūpadhṛk ..
brahmeśaśeṣadharmendrā vedavedāṃgapāragāḥ ..89..
4.19.d:
सर्वेषामीश्वरः साक्षी सर्वात्मा सर्वरूपधृक् ॥
ब्रह्मेशशेषधर्मेन्द्रा वेदवेदांगपारगाः ॥89॥
4.19.m:
the Lord of all, the witness, the Self of all, bearing all forms.
Brahmā, Īśa, Śeṣa, Dharma, and Indra, who have mastered the Vedas and Vedāṅgas,

4.19.s:
stotuṃ yamīśaṃ te jāḍyāḥ sarpaḥ stoṣyati taṃ vibhum ..
he nātha karuṇāsiṃdho dīnabaṃdho kṣamādhamam .. 4.19.90 ..
4.19.d:
स्तोतुं यमीशं ते जाड्याः सर्पः स्तोष्यति तं विभुम् ॥
हे नाथ करुणासिंधो दीनबंधो क्षमाधमम् ॥ 4.19.90 ॥
4.19.m:
are sluggish in praising that Lord—how then shall a serpent praise that all-pervading one?
O Master, ocean of compassion, friend of the poor, forgive this vile one!

4.19.s:
khalasvabhāvādajñānātkṛṣṇa tvaṃ carvito mayā ..
nāstralakṣyo yathākāśo na dṛśyāṃto na laṃghyakaḥ .. 91 ..
4.19.d:
खलस्वभावादज्ञानात्कृष्ण त्वं चर्वितो मया ॥
नास्त्रलक्ष्यो यथाकाशो न दृश्यांतो न लंघ्यकः ॥ 91 ॥
4.19.m:
Due to a wicked nature and ignorance, O Kṛṣṇa, you were chewed by me.
Just as the sky is not a target for weapons, its end cannot be seen, and it cannot be crossed over,

4.19.s:
na spṛśyo hi na cāvaryastathā tejastvameva ca ..
ityevamuktvā nāgendraḥ papāta caraṇāmbuje .. 92 ..
4.19.d:
न स्पृश्यो हि न चावर्यस्तथा तेजस्त्वमेव च ॥
इत्येवमुक्त्वा नागेन्द्रः पपात चरणाम्बुजे ॥ 92 ॥
4.19.m:
nor touched, nor indeed covered, even so are you, the supreme splendour.
Having spoken thus, the serpent lord fell at his lotus feet.

4.19.s:
omityuktvā haristuṣṭaḥ sarvaṃ tasmai varaṃ dadau ..
nāgarājakṛtaṃ stotraṃ prātarutthāya yaḥ paṭhet .. 93 ..
4.19.d:
ओमित्युक्त्वा हरिस्तुष्टः सर्वं तस्मै वरं ददौ ॥
नागराजकृतं स्तोत्रं प्रातरुत्थाय यः पठेत् ॥ 93 ॥
4.19.m:
Saying 'Om,' Hari, well-pleased, granted him every boon.
Whoever, having risen at dawn, recites the hymn of praise composed by the king of serpents,

4.19.s:
tadvaṃśyānāṃ ca tasyaiva nāgebhyo na bhayaṃ bhavet ..
sa nāgaśayyāṃ kṛtvaiva svaptuṃ śaktaḥ sadā bhuvi .. 94 ..
4.19.d:
तद्वंश्यानां च तस्यैव नागेभ्यो न भयं भवेत् ॥
स नागशय्यां कृत्वैव स्वप्तुं शक्तः सदा भुवि ॥ 94 ॥
4.19.m:
for him and for his descendants there shall be no fear of serpents.
Making a bed of serpents, he is able to sleep on the earth at all times.

4.19.s:
viṣapīyūṣayorbhedo nāstyeva tasya bhakṣaṇe ..
nāgagraste nāgaghāte prāṇānte viṣabhojanāt .. 99 ..
4.19.d:
विषपीयूषयोर्भेदो नास्त्येव तस्य भक्षणे ॥
नागग्रस्ते नागघाते प्राणान्ते विषभोजनात् ॥ 99 ॥
4.19.m:
There is no difference between poison and nectar for him when eaten.
When seized by a serpent, struck by a serpent, or at the end of life from eating poison,

4.19.s:
stotrasmaraṇamātreṇa sustho bhavati mānavaḥ ..
bhūrje kṛtvā stotramidaṃ kaṇṭhe vā dakṣiṇe kare ..96..
4.19.d:
स्तोत्रस्मरणमात्रेण सुस्थो भवति मानवः ॥
भूर्जे कृत्वा स्तोत्रमिदं कण्ठे वा दक्षिणे करे ॥96॥
4.19.m:
by merely remembering the hymn of praise, a man becomes well.
Having written this hymn of praise on birch bark, around the neck or on the right hand,

4.19.s:
bibharti yo bhaktiyukto nāgebhyo'pi na tadbhayam ..
yatra gehe stotramidaṃ nāgastatra na tiṣṭhati .. 97 ..
4.19.d:
बिभर्ति यो भक्तियुक्तो नागेभ्योऽपि न तद्भयम् ॥
यत्र गेहे स्तोत्रमिदं नागस्तत्र न तिष्ठति ॥ 97 ॥
4.19.m:
whoever wears it with devotion has no fear even of serpents.
In whatever house this hymn of praise is found, a serpent does not stay there.

4.19.s:
viṣāgnivajrabhītiśca na bhavettatra niścitam ..
iha loke harerbhaktiṃ smṛtiṃ ca satataṃ labhet ..
ante ca svakulaṃ pūtvā dāsyaṃ ca labhate dhruvam .. 98 ..
4.19.d:
विषाग्निवज्रभीतिश्च न भवेत्तत्र निश्चितम् ॥
इह लोके हरेर्भक्तिं स्मृतिं च सततं लभेत् ॥
अन्ते च स्वकुलं पूत्वा दास्यं च लभते ध्रुवम् ॥ 98 ॥
4.19.m:
Fear of poison, fire, and lightning will certainly not exist there.
In this world he constantly attains devotion to Hari and remembrance [of him],
and in the end, having purified his family, he surely attains service [to him].

4.19.s:
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ..
nāgendrāya varaṃ dattvā punastaṃ jagadīśvaraḥ ..
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ pariṇāmasukhāvaham .. 99 ..
4.19.d:
श्रीनारायण उवाच ॥
नागेन्द्राय वरं दत्त्वा पुनस्तं जगदीश्वरः ॥
उवाच मधुरं वाक्यं परिणामसुखावहम् ॥ 99 ॥
4.19.m:
Having granted the boon to the serpent lord, the Lord of the universe again
spoke sweet words to him, bringing happiness in their outcome.

4.19.s:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ..
gaccha tvaṃ ca ramaṇakaṃ yathendranagaraṃ param .. .. 4.19.100 ..
4.19.d:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥
गच्छ त्वं च रमणकं यथेन्द्रनगरं परम् ॥ ॥ 4.19.100 ॥
4.19.m: Go to Ramaṇaka, which is like the supreme city of Indra,

4.19.s:
sārddhaṃ svagoṣṭhyā nāgendra yamunājalavartmanā..
śrutvā nāgo harerājñāṃ ruroda premavihvalaḥ .. 101 ..
4.19.d:
सार्द्धं स्वगोष्ठ्या नागेन्द्र यमुनाजलवर्त्मना॥
श्रुत्वा नागो हरेराज्ञां रुरोद प्रेमविह्वलः ॥ 101 ॥
4.19.m:
together with your kin, O serpent lord, by way of the water-path of the Yamunā.
Hearing the command of Hari, the serpent wept, overcome with love.

4.19.s:
kadā drakṣyāmi tvatpādapadmaṃ nāthetyuvāca ha ..
praṇamya śatakṛtvaśca striyā goṣṭhyā saheśvaram .. 102 ..
4.19.d:
कदा द्रक्ष्यामि त्वत्पादपद्मं नाथेत्युवाच ह ॥
प्रणम्य शतकृत्वश्च स्त्रिया गोष्ठ्या सहेश्वरम् ॥ 102 ॥
4.19.m:
Saying, 'When shall I see your lotus feet, O Master?',
and having bowed a hundred times to the Lord with his wife and kin,

4.19.s:
jagāma jalamārgeṇa nāgendro virahāturaḥ ..
yamunā hradatoyaṃ ca babhūvāmṛtakalpakam .. 103 ..
4.19.d:
जगाम जलमार्गेण नागेन्द्रो विरहातुरः ॥
यमुना ह्रदतोयं च बभूवामृतकल्पकम् ॥ 103 ॥
4.19.m:
the serpent lord departed by the water-path, distressed by separation.
And the water of the Yamunā lake became like nectar;

4.19.s:
prasannā jantavaḥ sarve babhūvustena nārada ..
gatvā dadarśa bhavanaṃ yathendranagaraṃ param .. 104 ..
4.19.d:
प्रसन्ना जन्तवः सर्वे बभूवुस्तेन नारद ॥
गत्वा ददर्श भवनं यथेन्द्रनगरं परम् ॥ 104 ॥
4.19.m:
thereby all living beings became delighted, O Nārada.
Having gone, he saw an abode like the supreme city of Indra,

4.19.s:
ājñayā ca kṛpāsindhornirmitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā ..
tatra tasthau ca nāgendraḥ striyā putragaṇaiḥ saha ..105..
4.19.d:
आज्ञया च कृपासिन्धोर्निर्मितं विश्वकर्मणा ॥
तत्र तस्थौ च नागेन्द्रः स्त्रिया पुत्रगणैः सह ॥105॥
4.19.m:
built by Viśvakarman at the command of the ocean of compassion.
And there the serpent lord dwelt with his wife and sons,

4.19.s:
niḥśaṅko harṣayuktaśca haribhāvana tatparaḥ ..
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ hareścaritamadbhutam ..
sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ sāraṃ paraṃ kiṃ śrotumicchasi .. 106 ..
4.19.d:
निःशङ्को हर्षयुक्तश्च हरिभावन तत्परः ॥
इत्येवं कथितं सर्वं हरेश्चरितमद्भुतम् ॥
सुखदं मोक्षदं सारं परं किं श्रोतुमिच्छसि ॥ 106 ॥
4.19.m:
free from fear, full of joy, and intent on meditating upon Hari.
Thus the entire wondrous deed of Hari has been related,
which grants happiness and liberation, the supreme essence; what further do you wish to hear?

4.19.s:
sūta uvāca ..
maharṣervacanaṃ śrutvā nārado harṣavihvalaḥ ..
ṛṣiṃ papraccha saṃdehaṃ sarvasaṃdehabhañjanam .. 107 ..
4.19.d:
सूत उवाच ॥
महर्षेर्वचनं श्रुत्वा नारदो हर्षविह्वलः ॥
ऋषिं पप्रच्छ संदेहं सर्वसंदेहभञ्जनम् ॥ 107 ॥
4.19.m:
Having heard the words of the great sage, Nārada, overcome with joy,
questioned the sage about a doubt, he who destroys all doubt.

4.19.s:
nārada uvāca ..
kathaṃ vihāya kālīyaḥ svapūrvabhavanaṃ param ..
jagāma yamunātīraṃ tanme brūhi jagadguro .. 108 ..
4.19.d:
नारद उवाच ॥
कथं विहाय कालीयः स्वपूर्वभवनं परम् ॥
जगाम यमुनातीरं तन्मे ब्रूहि जगद्गुरो ॥ 108 ॥
4.19.m:
How did Kālīya, leaving his supreme ancestral home,
go to the bank of the Yamunā? Tell me that, O Guru of the Universe! / 108

4.19.s:
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ..
śṛṇu nārada vakṣye'hamitihāsaṃ purātanam .. 109 ..
4.19.d:
श्रीनारायण उवाच ॥
शृणु नारद वक्ष्येऽहमितिहासं पुरातनम् ॥ 109 ॥

4.19.s:
yacchrutaṃ dharmavaktrānme malaye sūryaparvaṇi ..
kṛṣṇākhyānaprasaṅgena suprabhā paścime taṭe .. 4.19.110 ..
4.19.d:
यच्छ्रुतं धर्मवक्त्रान्मे मलये सूर्यपर्वणि ॥
कृष्णाख्यानप्रसङ्गेन सुप्रभा पश्चिमे तटे ॥ 4.19.110 ॥
4.19.m:
which was heard by me from the mouth of Dharma on the Malaya [mountain] during a solar eclipse,
in the context of the story of Kṛṣṇa, on the western bank of the Suprabhā. / 4.19.110

4.19.s:
papraccha dharmaṃ pulahaḥ kathitaṃ munisaṃsadi ..
idamākhyānamāścaryamuvāca taṃ kṛpānidhiḥ .. 111 ..
4.19.d:
पप्रच्छ धर्मं पुलहः कथितं मुनिसंसदि ॥
इदमाख्यानमाश्चर्यमुवाच तं कृपानिधिः ॥ 111 ॥
4.19.m:
Pulaha questioned Dharma in an assembly of sages;
and the ocean of compassion spoke this wondrous narrative to him. / 111

4.19.s:
tatra śrutaṃ mayā vipra nibodha kathayāmi te ..
śeṣājñayā nāgagaṇā pratisaṃvatsaraṃ bhiyā .. 112 ..
4.19.d:
तत्र श्रुतं मया विप्र निबोध कथयामि ते ॥
शेषाज्ञया नागगणा प्रतिसंवत्सरं भिया ॥ 112 ॥
4.19.m:
Hear it as it was heard by me there, O brāhmaṇa, I tell it to you:
By order of Śeṣa, out of fear, the serpent hosts every year / 112

4.19.s:
kārtikīpūrṇimāyāṃ tu kurvanti garuḍārcanam ..
puṣpairdhūpaiśca dīpaiśca naivedyairbalibhirmudā .. 113 ..
4.19.d:
कार्तिकीपूर्णिमायां तु कुर्वन्ति गरुडार्चनम् ॥
पुष्पैर्धूपैश्च दीपैश्च नैवेद्यैर्बलिभिर्मुदा ॥ 113 ॥
4.19.m:
perform the worship of Garuḍa on the full moon of Kārttika,
with flowers, incense, lamps, food-offerings, and oblations, gladly, / 113

4.19.s:
puṣkare ca mahātīrthe susnātā bhaktisaṃyutāḥ ..
tasya pūjāṃ ca kālīyo na cakārātyahaṃkṛtaḥ .. 114 ..
4.19.d:
पुष्करे च महातीर्थे सुस्नाता भक्तिसंयुताः ॥
तस्य पूजां च कालीयो न चकारात्यहंकृतः ॥ 114 ॥
4.19.m:
having bathed well and filled with devotion at the great sacred place Puṣkara.
Yet, exceedingly arrogant, Kālīya did not perform worship to him; / 114

4.19.s:
nāgapūjopakaraṇaṃ balādbhakṣitumudyataḥ ..
cakrurnivāraṇaṃ nāgā nītimūcurmadoddhatam ..115..
4.19.d:
नागपूजोपकरणं बलाद्भक्षितुमुद्यतः ॥
चक्रुर्निवारणं नागा नीतिमूचुर्मदोद्धतम् ॥115॥
4.19.m:
by force he prepared to devour the offerings of the serpents' worship.
The serpents restrained him and spoke wise counsel to him haughty with arrogance. / 115

4.19.s:
na śaktā vāraṇe te cetyāvirbhūtaḥ khageśvaraḥ ..
dṛṣṭvā khageśvaraṃ nāgāḥ kālīyaprāṇarakṣayā ..116..
4.19.d:
न शक्ता वारणे ते चेत्याविर्भूतः खगेश्वरः ॥
दृष्ट्वा खगेश्वरं नागाः कालीयप्राणरक्षया ॥116॥
4.19.m:
When they were unable to restrain him, the Lord of Birds appeared.
Seeing the Lord of Birds, the serpents, wishing to protect Kālīya’s life, / 116

4.19.s:
prāṇaśaktyā ca yuyudhuryāvatsūryodayaṃ mune ..
pakṣīndratejasā sarve samudvignāḥ palāyitāḥ .. 117 ..
4.19.d:
प्राणशक्त्या च युयुधुर्यावत्सूर्योदयं मुने ॥
पक्षीन्द्रतेजसा सर्वे समुद्विग्नाः पलायिताः ॥ 117 ॥
4.19.m:
fought with all their life’s strength until sunrise, O sage.
Distressed by the splendour of the king of birds, they all fled; / 117

4.19.s:
anantaṃ śaraṇaṃ jagmuḥ sarveṣāmabhayapradam ..
palāyanaparāndṛṣṭvā nāgāṃśca karuṇānidhiḥ .. 118 ..
4.19.d:
अनन्तं शरणं जग्मुः सर्वेषामभयप्रदम् ॥
पलायनपरान्दृष्ट्वा नागांश्च करुणानिधिः ॥ 118 ॥
4.19.m:
they went for refuge to Ananta, who grants fearlessness to all.
Seeing the serpents intent on fleeing, the ocean of compassion [Garuḍa] / 118

4.19.s:
tatra tasthau ca niḥśaṅkaḥ kālīyastaṃ dadarśa ha ..
smṛtvā haripadāmbhojaṃ kālīyo yuyudhe mune .. 119 ...
4.19.d:
तत्र तस्थौ च निःशङ्कः कालीयस्तं ददर्श ह ॥
स्मृत्वा हरिपदाम्भोजं कालीयो युयुधे मुने ॥ 119 ॥।
4.19.m:
stood there without fear, and Kālīya saw him.
Remembering Hari's lotus feet, Kālīya fought, O sage. / 119

4.19.s:
muhūrtaṃ ca tayoryuddhaṃ babhūvātīva dāruṇam ..
parājitaśca nāgendrastejasā garuḍasya ca .. 4.19.120 ..
4.19.d:
मुहूर्तं च तयोर्युद्धं बभूवातीव दारुणम् ॥
पराजितश्च नागेन्द्रस्तेजसा गरुडस्य च ॥ 4.19.120 ॥
4.19.m:
And their battle lasted for a muhūrta, exceedingly terrible;
and the lord of serpents was defeated by Garuḍa's splendour. / 4.19.120

4.19.s:
bhiyā palāyanaṃ kṛtvā jagāma yamunā hradam ..
na taṃ saubhariśāpena khagendro gantumīśvaraḥ ..
tatra tasthau bhiyā nāgo jagmuḥ paścācca tadgaṇāḥ .. 121 ..
4.19.d:
भिया पलायनं कृत्वा जगाम यमुना ह्रदम् ॥
न तं सौभरिशापेन खगेन्द्रो गन्तुमीश्वरः ॥
तत्र तस्थौ भिया नागो जग्मुः पश्चाच्च तद्गणाः ॥ 121 ॥

4.19.s:
nārada uvāca ..
kathaṃ tu saubhareḥ śāpo babhūva garuḍāya vai ..
kathaṃ na śakto gantuṃ taṃ hradamīśvaravāhanaḥ .. 122 ..
4.19.d:
नारद उवाच ॥
कथं तु सौभरेः शापो बभूव गरुडाय वै ॥
कथं न शक्तो गन्तुं तं ह्रदमीश्वरवाहनः ॥ 122 ॥
4.19.m:
How indeed did Saubhari's curse fall upon Garuḍa?
Why was the vehicle of the Lord unable to go to that pool? / 122

4.19.s:
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ..
divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ ca varṣāṇāṃ tatra saubhariḥ ..123..
4.19.d:
श्रीनारायण उवाच ॥
दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रं च वर्षाणां तत्र सौभरिः ॥123॥
4.19.m: For a divine thousand years there Saubhari, / 123

4.19.s:
tapastaptvā mahāsiddho dadhyau kṛṣṇapadāmbujam ..
samīpe dhyāyamānasya kūle ca yamunā jale .. 124 ..
4.19.d:
तपस्तप्त्वा महासिद्धो दध्यौ कृष्णपदाम्बुजम् ॥
समीपे ध्यायमानस्य कूले च यमुना जले ॥ 124 ॥
4.19.m:
a great perfected sage, having performed austerities, meditated on Kṛṣṇa's lotus feet.
Near him while meditating, on the bank, in the water of the Yamunā, / 124

4.19.s:
gaṇena sārdhaṃ niḥśaṃkaḥ karoti bhramaṇaṃ mudā ..
pucchamutphālya bahudhā paritaḥ paramecchayā .. 125 ..
4.19.d:
गणेन सार्धं निःशंकः करोति भ्रमणं मुदा ॥
पुच्छमुत्फाल्य बहुधा परितः परमेच्छया ॥ 125 ॥
4.19.m:
[a fish] with his kin, without fear, swam about happily,
flapping his tail repeatedly in all directions at his supreme will, / 125

4.19.s:
muniṃ pradakṣiṇī kṛtya yātyāyāti mudā'nvitaḥ ..
sakulaṃ sumahātmānaṃ darśaṃdarśaṃ khagādhipaḥ ..126..
4.19.d:
मुनिं प्रदक्षिणी कृत्य यात्यायाति मुदाऽन्वितः ॥
सकुलं सुमहात्मानं दर्शंदर्शं खगाधिपः ॥126॥
4.19.m:
and having circumambulated the sage, went and came back, filled with delight.
Watching again and again that very noble one along with his kin, the lord of birds / 126

4.19.s:
jagrāha cañcunā mīnaṃ munīndrasya samīpataḥ ..
gacchantaṃ taṃ mīnamukhaṃ dadarśa kopacakṣuṣā .. 127 ..
4.19.d:
जग्राह चञ्चुना मीनं मुनीन्द्रस्य समीपतः ॥
गच्छन्तं तं मीनमुखं ददर्श कोपचक्षुषा ॥ 127 ॥
4.19.m:
seized the fish with his beak near the lord of sages.
[The sage] looked with an angry eye upon him who had the fish in his mouth and was leaving. / 127

4.19.s:
prakopito munerdṛṣṭyā mīnastoye papāta ha ..
tamuvāca munīndraśca punarādātumudyatam ..
mīnaśca garuḍatrāsāttasthau munisamīpataḥ .. 128 ..
4.19.d:
प्रकोपितो मुनेर्दृष्ट्या मीनस्तोये पपात ह ॥
तमुवाच मुनीन्द्रश्च पुनरादातुमुद्यतम् ॥
मीनश्च गरुडत्रासात्तस्थौ मुनिसमीपतः ॥ 128 ॥

4.19.s:
saubhariruvāca ..
gaccha dūraṃ gaccha dūraṃ khagendra matsamīpataḥ .. 129 ..
4.19.d:
सौभरिरुवाच ॥
गच्छ दूरं गच्छ दूरं खगेन्द्र मत्समीपतः ॥ 129 ॥
4.19.m: "Go far away, go far away from my presence, O king of birds! / 129

4.19.s:
kā yogyatā matpuraste grahītuṃ jīvamulbaṇam..
śrīkṛṣṇavāhanaṃ jñātvā cātmānaṃ bahu manyase ..4.19.130..
4.19.d:
का योग्यता मत्पुरस्ते ग्रहीतुं जीवमुल्बणम्॥
श्रीकृष्णवाहनं ज्ञात्वा चात्मानं बहु मन्यसे ॥4.19.130॥
4.19.m:
What fitness have you to seize a fierce living creature before me?
Knowing yourself to be Śrī Kṛṣṇa's vehicle, you think highly of yourself! / 4.19.130

4.19.s:
tvadvidhānkoṭiśaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sraṣṭuṃ śaktaśca vāhakān ..
karomi bhasmasāttūrṇaṃ tvāṃ ca bhrūbhaṅgalīlayā .. 131 ..
4.19.d:
त्वद्विधान्कोटिशः कृष्णः स्रष्टुं शक्तश्च वाहकान् ॥
करोमि भस्मसात्तूर्णं त्वां च भ्रूभङ्गलीलया ॥ 131 ॥
4.19.m:
Kṛṣṇa is able to create tens of millions of carriers like you!
I can instantly turn you to ashes with the play of a knit brow! / 131

4.19.s:
vāhanaṃ ca tvamīśasya na vayaṃ tava kiṃkarāḥ ..
adya prabhṛti pakṣīndra yadyāgacchasi me hradam .. 132 ..
4.19.d:
वाहनं च त्वमीशस्य न वयं तव किंकराः ॥
अद्य प्रभृति पक्षीन्द्र यद्यागच्छसि मे ह्रदम् ॥ 132 ॥
4.19.m:
You are the vehicle of the Lord, but we are not your servants!
From this day forth, O king of birds, if you come to my pool, / 132

4.19.s:
madīyaśāpāttūrṇaṃ ca bhasmasādbhavitā dhruvam ..
munīndrasya vacaḥ śrutvā pracacāla khageśvaraḥ .. 133 ..
4.19.d:
मदीयशापात्तूर्णं च भस्मसाद्भविता ध्रुवम् ॥
मुनीन्द्रस्य वचः श्रुत्वा प्रचचाल खगेश्वरः ॥ 133 ॥
4.19.m:
surely you will instantly turn to ashes by my curse!"
Hearing the words of the lord of sages, the Lord of Birds departed; / 133

4.19.s:
smāraṃsmāraṃ kṛṣṇapādaṃ taṃ praṇamya jagāma ha ..
adyaprabhṛti viprendra patagendrasya saṃtatam .. 134 ..
4.19.d:
स्मारंस्मारं कृष्णपादं तं प्रणम्य जगाम ह ॥
अद्यप्रभृति विप्रेन्द्र पतगेन्द्रस्य संततम् ॥ 134 ॥
4.19.m:
remembering Kṛṣṇa’s feet again and again, having bowed to him, he went away.
From this day forth, O best of brāhmaṇas, the lord of birds constantly / 134

4.19.s:
hradasya śrutimātreṇa kampo bhavati niścitam ..
itihāsaśca kathito yaḥ śruto dharmavaktrataḥ .. 135 ..
4.19.d:
ह्रदस्य श्रुतिमात्रेण कम्पो भवति निश्चितम् ॥
इतिहासश्च कथितो यः श्रुतो धर्मवक्त्रतः ॥ 135 ॥
4.19.m:
certainly trembles at the mere mention of that pool.
And this story has been told which was heard from the mouth of Dharma, / 135

4.19.s:
sarahasyaṃ śrutisukhaṃ prakṛtaṃ śṛṇu maṅgalam ..
vijñāya suciraṃ bālā nottasthau tajjalāddhariḥ .. 136 ..
4.19.d:
सरहस्यं श्रुतिसुखं प्रकृतं शृणु मङ्गलम् ॥
विज्ञाय सुचिरं बाला नोत्तस्थौ तज्जलाद्धरिः ॥ 136 ॥
4.19.m:
endowed with secret meaning and sweet to the ear; hear now the auspicious subject at hand.
Knowing that for a very long time Hari did not rise from that water, the boys

4.19.s:
cakrurviṣādaṃ mohācca ruruduryamunātaṭe ..
svavakṣoghātanaṃ cakruḥ kecidbālāḥ śucā''kulāḥ .. 137 ..
4.19.d:
चक्रुर्विषादं मोहाच्च रुरुदुर्यमुनातटे ॥
स्ववक्षोघातनं चक्रुः केचिद्बालाः शुचा'ऽकुलाः ॥ 137 ॥
4.19.m:
sank into despair from delusion and wept on the bank of the Yamunā.
Agitated by grief, some boys beat their own chests;

4.19.s:
kecinnipatya bhūmau ca mūrcchāṃ prāpuhariṃ vinā ..
hradaṃ praveṣṭuṃ kecicca viraheṇa samanvitāḥ..138..
4.19.d:
केचिन्निपत्य भूमौ च मूर्च्छां प्रापुहरिं विना ॥
ह्रदं प्रवेष्टुं केचिच्च विरहेण समन्विताः॥138॥
4.19.m:
some fell to the ground and fainted without Hari;
some, overcome by separation, [were about] to enter the pool;

4.19.s:
kecidgopālabālāśca cakruśca tannivāraṇam ..
kṛtvā vilāpaṃ kecicca prāṇāṃstyaktuṃ samudyatāḥ ..139..
4.19.d:
केचिद्गोपालबालाश्च चक्रुश्च तन्निवारणम् ॥
कृत्वा विलापं केचिच्च प्राणांस्त्यक्तुं समुद्यताः ॥139॥
4.19.m:
and some cowherd boys restrained them.
Some, after wailing, prepared to give up their lives;

4.19.s:
teṣāṃ kecijjñānavanto rakṣāṃ cakruḥ prayatnataḥ ..
kecidūcuśca hāheti kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇeti kecana .. 4.19.140 ..
4.19.d:
तेषां केचिज्ज्ञानवन्तो रक्षां चक्रुः प्रयत्नतः ॥
केचिदूचुश्च हाहेति कृष्ण कृष्णेति केचन ॥ 4.19.140 ॥
4.19.m:
some wise ones among them made effort to protect them.
Some cried, "Alas! Alas!", and some cried, "O Kṛṣṇa! O Kṛṣṇa!";

4.19.s:
kecidvaktuṃ pravṛttiṃ ca prayayurnandasannidhim ..
kecitsaṃmīlitāstatra śokamohabhayāturāḥ .. 141 ..
4.19.d:
केचिद्वक्तुं प्रवृत्तिं च प्रययुर्नन्दसन्निधिम् ॥
केचित्संमीलितास्तत्र शोकमोहभयातुराः ॥ 141 ॥
4.19.m:
some went into the presence of Nanda to report the news.
Some gathered together there, afflicted with grief, delusion, and fear;

4.19.s:
ityūcuḥ kiṃ kariṣyāmaḥ kuto'smākaṃ gato hariḥ ..
he nandasūno he kṛṣṇa prāṇebhyo'pyadhikapriya .. 142 ..
4.19.d:
इत्यूचुः किं करिष्यामः कुतोऽस्माकं गतो हरिः ॥
हे नन्दसूनो हे कृष्ण प्राणेभ्योऽप्यधिकप्रिय ॥ 142 ॥
4.19.m:
they said: "What shall we do? Where has our Hari gone?
O son of Nanda! O Kṛṣṇa! Dearer than life itself!

4.19.s:
he bandho darśanaṃ dehītyūcuḥ prāṇāḥ prayānti hi ..
etasminnantare kecidbālakā nandasannidhim .. 143 ..
4.19.d:
हे बन्धो दर्शनं देहीत्यूचुः प्राणाः प्रयान्ति हि ॥
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे केचिद्बालका नन्दसन्निधिम् ॥ 143 ॥
4.19.m:
O friend, show yourself!" they said, "for our lives are departing!"
In the meantime, some boys came into the presence of Nanda,

4.19.s:
saṃprāpuratilolāśca rudantaḥ śokavihvalāḥ ..
pravṛttimūcustaṃ śīghraṃ yaśodāṃ mūlato balam ..144..
4.19.d:
संप्रापुरतिलोलाश्च रुदन्तः शोकविह्वलाः ॥
प्रवृत्तिमूचुस्तं शीघ्रं यशोदां मूलतो बलम् ॥144॥
4.19.m:
greatly distressed, weeping, overwhelmed with grief;
they spoke the news quickly, from the beginning, to him, to Yaśodā, and to Bala,

4.19.s:
gopāngopālikāścaiva raktapaṅkajalocanāḥ ..
śrutvā vārtāṃ ca te sarve śīghraṃ jagmuḥ śucā'nvitāḥ ..145..
4.19.d:
गोपान्गोपालिकाश्चैव रक्तपङ्कजलोचनाः ॥
श्रुत्वा वार्तां च ते सर्वे शीघ्रं जग्मुः शुचाऽन्विताः ॥145॥
4.19.m:
their eyes [red as] red lotuses, as well as to the cowherds and cowherd women.
And hearing that news, they all went quickly, filled with grief,

4.19.s:
kalindanandinītīraṃ rurudurbālakairyutāḥ ..
gatvā saṃmīlitāḥ sarve ruruduḥ śokamūrcchitāḥ..146..
4.19.d:
कलिन्दनन्दिनीतीरं रुरुदुर्बालकैर्युताः ॥
गत्वा संमीलिताः सर्वे रुरुदुः शोकमूर्च्छिताः॥146॥
4.19.m:
to the bank of the daughter of Kalinda [Yamunā], weeping along with the boys.
Having arrived and assembled together, they all wept, fainting from grief.

4.19.s:
hradaṃ viśantīmambāṃ tāṃ keciccakrurnivāraṇam ..
gopā gopālikāścaiva jaghnuraṅgāni śokataḥ ..147..
4.19.d:
ह्रदं विशन्तीमम्बां तां केचिच्चक्रुर्निवारणम् ॥
गोपा गोपालिकाश्चैव जघ्नुरङ्गानि शोकतः ॥147॥
4.19.m:
Some restrained that mother who was entering the pool;
the cowherds and cowherd women struck their limbs out of sorrow.

4.19.s:
kecidvilalapustatra mūrcchāṃ prāpuśca kecana ..
hradaṃ viśantīṃ tāṃ rādhāṃ vārayāmāsa kācana .. 148 ..
4.19.d:
केचिद्विललपुस्तत्र मूर्च्छां प्रापुश्च केचन ॥
ह्रदं विशन्तीं तां राधां वारयामास काचन ॥ 148 ॥
4.19.m:
Some wailed there, and some fainted;
a certain woman held back that Rādhā who was entering the pool.

4.19.s:
mūrcchāṃ ca prāpa sā śokānmṛteva ca sarittaṭe ..
vilapyātibhṛśaṃ nando mūrcchāṃ prāpa punaḥ punaḥ .. 149 ..
4.19.d:
मूर्च्छां च प्राप सा शोकान्मृतेव च सरित्तटे ॥
विलप्यातिभृशं नन्दो मूर्च्छां प्राप पुनः पुनः ॥ 149 ॥
4.19.m:
And she fainted from grief on the riverbank as if dead.
Lamenting exceedingly, Nanda fainted again and again;

4.19.s:
bhūyo'pi rodanaṃ kṛtvā bhūyo mūrcchāmavāpa ha ..
vilapantaṃ bhṛśaṃ nandaṃ yaśodāṃ śokakarśitām .. 4.19.150 ..
4.19.d:
भूयोऽपि रोदनं कृत्वा भूयो मूर्च्छामवाप ह ॥
विलपन्तं भृशं नन्दं यशोदां शोककर्शिताम् ॥ 4.19.150 ॥
4.19.m:
weeping once more, he fell into a faint again.
To Nanda who was lamenting intensely, to Yaśodā emaciated by grief,

4.19.s:
gopāśca gopikāścaiva rādhikāmatimūrcchitām ..
rudato bālakānsarvānbālikāśca śucā'nvitāḥ ..
sarvāṃśca bodhayāmāsa balaśca jñānināṃ varaḥ .. 151 ..
4.19.d:
गोपाश्च गोपिकाश्चैव राधिकामतिमूर्च्छिताम् ॥
रुदतो बालकान्सर्वान्बालिकाश्च शुचाऽन्विताः ॥
सर्वांश्च बोधयामास बलश्च ज्ञानिनां वरः ॥ 151 ॥
4.19.m:
to the cowherds and the cowherd women, to Rādhikā who had deeply swooned,
to all the weeping boys and the girls filled with grief,
Bala, best among the wise, gave counsel to them all.

4.19.s:
śrībaladeva uvāca ..
gopā gopālikā bālāḥ sarve śṛṇuta madvacaḥ .. 152 ..
4.19.d:
श्रीबलदेव उवाच ॥
गोपा गोपालिका बालाः सर्वे शृणुत मद्वचः ॥ 152 ॥
4.19.m: "O cowherds, cowherd women, children, listen all to my words!

4.19.s:
he nanda jñānināṃ śreṣṭha gargavākyasmṛtiṃ kuru ..
jagadbibhartuḥ śeṣasya saṃhartuḥ śaṃkarasya ca ..153..
4.19.d:
हे नन्द ज्ञानिनां श्रेष्ठ गर्गवाक्यस्मृतिं कुरु ॥
जगद्बिभर्तुः शेषस्य संहर्तुः शंकरस्य च ॥153॥
4.19.m:
O Nanda, best among the wise, remember the words of Garga!
Of the bearer of the universe, Śeṣa, and of the destroyer, Śaṅkara,

4.19.s:
vidhātuḥ saṃvidhātuśca bhuvi kasmātparājayaḥ ..
paramāṇuḥ paro vyūhaḥ sthūlātsthūlaḥ parātparaḥ .. 154 ..
4.19.d:
विधातुः संविधातुश्च भुवि कस्मात्पराजयः ॥
परमाणुः परो व्यूहः स्थूलात्स्थूलः परात्परः ॥ 154 ॥
4.19.m:
and of the creator and disposer, whence could defeat come on earth?
He is an atom, the supreme array, grosser than the gross, higher than the high;

4.19.s:
vidyamāno'pyavidṛśyaḥ saṃyogo yogināmapi ..
diśāṃ nāsti samāhāraḥ spṛśyo nākāśa eva ca .. 155 ..
4.19.d:
विद्यमानोऽप्यविदृश्यः संयोगो योगिनामपि ॥
दिशां नास्ति समाहारः स्पृश्यो नाकाश एव च ॥ 155 ॥
4.19.m:
though present, he cannot be seen [even] in the conjunction of yogins.
There is no gathering of the directions, and space itself cannot be touched;

4.19.s:
api sarveśvaro bādhya ityūcuḥ śrutayaḥ sphuṭam ..
nātmā dṛśyo nāstralakṣyo na vadhyo na hi dṛśyakaḥ .. 155 ..
4.19.d:
अपि सर्वेश्वरो बाध्य इत्यूचुः श्रुतयः स्फुटम् ॥
नात्मा दृश्यो नास्त्रलक्ष्यो न वध्यो न हि दृश्यकः ॥ 155 ॥
4.19.m:
how could the Lord of all be constrained? Thus the Vedas clearly declare.
The Self cannot be seen, cannot be targeted by weapons, cannot be slain, and is not visible;

4.19.s:
nāgnigrasto na hiṃsyaścāpīdamādhyātmikā viduḥ ..
vigraho'syaiva kṛṣṇasya bhaktadhyānārthameva ca .. 157 ..
4.19.d:
नाग्निग्रस्तो न हिंस्यश्चापीदमाध्यात्मिका विदुः ॥
विग्रहोऽस्यैव कृष्णस्य भक्तध्यानार्थमेव च ॥ 157 ॥
4.19.m:
it is not seized by fire, nor can it be harmed—the knowers of the supreme Self know this.
This physical form of Kṛṣṇa is solely for the meditation of devotees,

4.19.s:
jyotiḥsvarūpasya vibhornādyantamadhyamātmanaḥ ..
jalaplute ca brahmāṇḍe jalaśāyī janārdanaḥ .. 158 ..
4.19.d:
ज्योतिःस्वरूपस्य विभोर्नाद्यन्तमध्यमात्मनः ॥
जलप्लुते च ब्रह्माण्डे जलशायी जनार्दनः ॥ 158 ॥
4.19.m:
of the all-pervading one whose nature is light, the Self without beginning, end, or middle.
When the cosmic egg is inundated with water, Janārdana lies upon the water;

4.19.s:
yannābhipadmajo brahmā tasyeśasya hrade vipat ..
maśakaścetkṣamo grastuṃ brahmāṇḍamakhilaṃ pitaḥ .. 159 ..
4.19.d:
यन्नाभिपद्मजो ब्रह्मा तस्येशस्य ह्रदे विपत् ॥
मशकश्चेत्क्षमो ग्रस्तुं ब्रह्माण्डमखिलं पितः ॥ 159 ॥
4.19.m:
Brahmā is born from his navel-lotus—can there be calamity in a pool for that Lord?
If a gnat were able to swallow the entire cosmic egg, O father,

4.19.s:
na tathā'pi tadīśaṃ taṃ grastuṃ sarpaḥ kṣamo bhavet ..
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvamādhyātmikamanuttamam .. 4.19.160 ..
4.19.d:
न तथाऽपि तदीशं तं ग्रस्तुं सर्पः क्षमो भवेत् ॥
इत्येवं कथितं सर्वमाध्यात्मिकमनुत्तमम् ॥ 4.19.160 ॥
4.19.m:
even then a serpent could not be able to swallow that Lord of it.
Thus all this supreme spiritual truth has been told,

4.19.s:
nigūḍhaṃ yogināṃ sāraṃ saṃśayacchedakāraṇam ..
baladevavacaḥ śrutvā gargavākyamanusmaran .. 161 ..
4.19.d:
निगूढं योगिनां सारं संशयच्छेदकारणम् ॥
बलदेववचः श्रुत्वा गर्गवाक्यमनुस्मरन् ॥ 161 ॥
4.19.m:
profound, the essence of yogins, the cause of cutting through doubt."
Hearing the words of Baladeva and remembering the words of Garga,

4.19.s:
tatyāja śokaṃ nandaśca vrajaśca vrajayoṣitaḥ ..
prabodhaṃ menire sarve na yaśodā na rādhikā .. 162 ..
4.19.d:
तत्याज शोकं नन्दश्च व्रजश्च व्रजयोषितः ॥
प्रबोधं मेनिरे सर्वे न यशोदा न राधिका ॥ 162 ॥
4.19.m:
Nanda gave up his grief, as did Vraja and the women of Vraja.
All accepted the consolation, but neither Yaśodā nor Rādhikā [could];

4.19.s:
bandhuvicchedaviṣaye prabodhe na sthitaṃ manaḥ ..
etasminnantare kṛṣṇamutpatantaṃ jalānmune .. 163 ..
4.19.d:
बन्धुविच्छेदविषये प्रबोधे न स्थितं मनः ॥
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे कृष्णमुत्पतन्तं जलान्मुने ॥ 163 ॥
4.19.m:
in the matter of separation from a beloved, the mind could not stay consoled.
At that moment, O sage, [seeing] Kṛṣṇa leaping up from the water,

4.19.s:
dadṛśustaṃ suprasannā vrajāśca vrajayoṣitaḥ ..
śaratpārvaṇacandrāsyaṃ sasmitaṃ sumanoharam .. 164 ..
4.19.d:
ददृशुस्तं सुप्रसन्ना व्रजाश्च व्रजयोषितः ॥
शरत्पार्वणचन्द्रास्यं सस्मितं सुमनोहरम् ॥ 164 ॥
4.19.m:
the people of Vraja and the women of Vraja beheld him, highly delighted,
with a face like the full moon of autumn, smiling, exceedingly charming,

4.19.s:
asnigdhavastramasnigdhamaluptacandanāñjanam ..
sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā .. 165 ..
4.19.d:
अस्निग्धवस्त्रमस्निग्धमलुप्तचन्दनाञ्जनम् ॥
सर्वाभरणसंयुक्तं ज्वलन्तं ब्रह्मतेजसा ॥ 165 ॥
4.19.m:
his garments undamped, dry, his sandalwood paste and eye-salve untouched,
adorned with all ornaments, blazing with the splendour of Brahman.

4.19.s:
mayūrapicchacūḍaṃ ca vaṃśīvadanamacyutam ..
yaśodā bālakaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛtvā vakṣasi sasmitā .. 166 ..
4.19.d:
मयूरपिच्छचूडं च वंशीवदनमच्युतम् ॥
यशोदा बालकं दृष्ट्वा कृत्वा वक्षसि सस्मिता ॥ 166 ॥
4.19.m:
with a peacock feather crest and a flute at his mouth, [he was] Acyuta.
Seeing the boy, Yaśodā, smiling, placed him upon her chest; / 166

4.19.s:
cucumba vadanāmbhojaṃ prasannavadanekṣaṇā ..
kroḍe cakāra nandaśca balaśca rohiṇī mudā .. 167 ..
4.19.d:
चुचुम्ब वदनाम्भोजं प्रसन्नवदनेक्षणा ॥
क्रोडे चकार नन्दश्च बलश्च रोहिणी मुदा ॥ 167 ॥
4.19.m:
with a cheerful face and eyes, she kissed his lotus face.
And Nanda, Bala, and Rohiṇī joyfully took him on their laps. / 167

4.19.s:
nimeṣarahitāḥ sarve dadṛśuḥ śrīmukhaṃ hareḥ ..
premāndhā bālakāḥ sarve cakrurāliṅganaṃ hareḥ .. 168 ..
4.19.d:
निमेषरहिताः सर्वे ददृशुः श्रीमुखं हरेः ॥
प्रेमान्धा बालकाः सर्वे चक्रुरालिङ्गनं हरेः ॥ 168 ॥
4.19.m:
Without blinking, they all gazed upon the glorious face of Hari.
Blinded by love, all the boys embraced Hari. / 168

4.19.s:
papuścakṣuścakoraiśca mukhacandraṃ ca gopikāḥ ..
etasminnantare tatra sahasā kānanāṃtaram .. 159 ..
4.19.d:
पपुश्चक्षुश्चकोरैश्च मुखचन्द्रं च गोपिकाः ॥
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र सहसा काननांतरम् ॥ 159 ॥
4.19.m:
And the cowherd women drank the moon of his face with the cakora birds of their eyes.
In the meantime, there suddenly within the forest, / 159

4.19.s:
dāvāgnirveṣṭayāmāsa taiḥ sarvaiḥ saha gokulam ..
dṛṣṭvā śailapramāṇāgniṃ paritaḥ kānanāntare .. 4.19.170 ..
4.19.d:
दावाग्निर्वेष्टयामास तैः सर्वैः सह गोकुलम् ॥
दृष्ट्वा शैलप्रमाणाग्निं परितः काननान्तरे ॥ 4.19.170 ॥
4.19.m:
a forest fire surrounded Gokula along with all of them.
Seeing the fire the size of a mountain all around within the forest, / 4.19.170

4.19.s:
praṇāśaṃ menire sarve bhayamāpuśca saṃkaṭe ..
śrīkṛṣṇaṃ tuṣṭuvuḥ sarve saṃpuṭāñjalayo vrajāḥ ..
bālā gopyaśca saṃtrastā bhaktinamrātmakandharāḥ .. 171 ..
4.19.d:
प्रणाशं मेनिरे सर्वे भयमापुश्च संकटे ॥
श्रीकृष्णं तुष्टुवुः सर्वे संपुटाञ्जलयो व्रजाः ॥
बाला गोप्यश्च संत्रस्ता भक्तिनम्रात्मकन्धराः ॥ 171 ॥
4.19.m:
they all considered themselves destroyed and were seized with fear in their peril.
With folded hands, all the inhabitants of Vraja praised Śrī Kṛṣṇa:
the boys and the terrified cowherd women, their necks bowed in devotion. / 171

4.19.s:
bālā ūcuḥ ..
yathā saṃrakṣitaṃ brahmansarvāpatsveva naḥ kulam .. .. 172 ..
4.19.d:
बाला ऊचुः ॥
यथा संरक्षितं ब्रह्मन्सर्वापत्स्वेव नः कुलम् ॥ ॥ 172 ॥
4.19.m: “Just as our people was thoroughly protected by you, O Brahman, in every danger, / 172

4.19.s:
tathā rakṣāṃ kuru punardāvāgnermadhusūdana ..
tvamiṣṭadevatā'smākaṃ tvameva kuladevatā .. 173 ..
4.19.d:
तथा रक्षां कुरु पुनर्दावाग्नेर्मधुसूदन ॥
त्वमिष्टदेवताऽस्माकं त्वमेव कुलदेवता ॥ 173 ॥
4.19.m:
so protect us once more, O Madhusūdana, from the forest fire!
You are our chosen deity; you alone are our family deity. / 173

4.19.s:
sraṣṭā pātā ca saṃhartā jagatāṃ ca jagatpate ..
vahnirvā varuṇo vā'pi candro vā sūrya eva ca .. 174 ..
4.19.d:
स्रष्टा पाता च संहर्ता जगतां च जगत्पते ॥
वह्निर्वा वरुणो वाऽपि चन्द्रो वा सूर्य एव च ॥ 174 ॥
4.19.m:
You are the creator, protector, and destroyer of the worlds, O Lord of the World!
Whether Agni, Varuṇa, the Moon, or the Sun, / 174

4.19.s:
yamaḥ kuberaḥ pavana īśānādyāśca devatāḥ ..
brahmeśaśeṣadharmendrā munīndrā manavaḥ smṛtāḥ .. 175 ..
4.19.d:
यमः कुबेरः पवन ईशानाद्याश्च देवताः ॥
ब्रह्मेशशेषधर्मेन्द्रा मुनीन्द्रा मनवः स्मृताः ॥ 175 ॥
4.19.m:
Yama, Kubera, Vāyu, or the gods beginning with Īśāna;
Brahmā, Śiva, Śeṣa, Dharma, and Indra, the chiefs of sages, and the Manus as traditionally handed down; / 175

4.19.s:
mānavāśca tathā daityā yakṣarākṣasakiṃnarāḥ ..
ye ye carācarāścaiva sarve tava vibhūtayaḥ .. 176 ..
4.19.d:
मानवाश्च तथा दैत्या यक्षराक्षसकिंनराः ॥
ये ये चराचराश्चैव सर्वे तव विभूतयः ॥ 176 ॥
4.19.m:
men as well as Daityas, Yakṣas, Rākṣasas, and Kiṃnaras—
whatever moving and unmoving beings there are, all are your manifestations. / 176

4.19.s:
āvirbhāvastirobhāvaḥ sarveṣāṃ ca tathecchayā..
abhayaṃ dehi goviṃda vahnisaṃharaṇaṃ kuru .. 177 ..
4.19.d:
आविर्भावस्तिरोभावः सर्वेषां च तथेच्छया॥
अभयं देहि गोविंद वह्निसंहरणं कुरु ॥ 177 ॥
4.19.m:
The appearance and disappearance of all beings happens according to your will.
Grant us safety, O Govinda! Put an end to the fire! / 177

4.19.s:
vayaṃ tvāṃ śaraṇaṃ yāmo rakṣa naḥ śaraṇāgatān ..
ityevamuktvā te sarve tasthurdhyātvā padāmbujam .. 178 ..
4.19.d:
वयं त्वां शरणं यामो रक्ष नः शरणागतान् ॥
इत्येवमुक्त्वा ते सर्वे तस्थुर्ध्यात्वा पदाम्बुजम् ॥ 178 ॥
4.19.m:
We go to you for refuge; protect us who have surrendered to you!”
Having spoken thus, they all stood meditating on his lotus feet. / 178

4.19.s:
dūrībhūtastu dāvāgniḥ śrīkṛṣṇāmṛtadṛṣṭitaḥ ..
dūrībhūte ca dāvāgnau nanṛtuste mudā'nvitāḥ .. 179 ..
4.19.d:
दूरीभूतस्तु दावाग्निः श्रीकृष्णामृतदृष्टितः ॥
दूरीभूते च दावाग्नौ ननृतुस्ते मुदाऽन्विताः ॥ 179 ॥
4.19.m:
The forest fire was driven far away merely by Śrī Kṛṣṇa's nectar-like glance.
And when the forest fire was driven away, filled with joy, they danced. / 179

4.19.s:
sarvāpadaḥ praṇaśyanti harismaraṇamātrataḥ ..
idaṃ stotraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ prātarutthāya yaḥ paṭhet .. 4.19.180 ..
4.19.d:
सर्वापदः प्रणश्यन्ति हरिस्मरणमात्रतः ॥
इदं स्तोत्रं महापुण्यं प्रातरुत्थाय यः पठेत् ॥ 4.19.180 ॥
4.19.m:
All calamities perish simply by the remembrance of Hari.
Whoever, having risen in the morning, recites this greatly meritorious hymn of praise / 4.19.180

4.19.s:
vahnito na bhavettasya bhayaṃ janmani janmani ..
śatrugraste ca dāvāgnau vipattau prāṇasaṅkaṭe .. 181 ..
4.19.d:
वह्नितो न भवेत्तस्य भयं जन्मनि जन्मनि ॥
शत्रुग्रस्ते च दावाग्नौ विपत्तौ प्राणसङ्कटे ॥ 181 ॥
4.19.m:
will have no fear of fire in birth after birth.
When seized by enemies, in a forest fire, in calamity, and when life is in danger, / 181

4.19.s:
stotrametatpaṭhitvā tu mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ..
śatrusainyaṃ kṣayaṃ yāti sarvatra vijayī bhavet ..
iha loke harerbhaktimante dāsyaṃ labheddhruvam .. 182 ..
4.19.d:
स्तोत्रमेतत्पठित्वा तु मुच्यते नात्र संशयः ॥
शत्रुसैन्यं क्षयं याति सर्वत्र विजयी भवेत् ॥
इह लोके हरेर्भक्तिमन्ते दास्यं लभेद्ध्रुवम् ॥ 182 ॥
4.19.m:
by reciting this hymn of praise, one is freed without a doubt.
The enemy host goes to destruction; one becomes victorious everywhere.

4.19.s:
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ..
dāvāgnimokṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā taiḥ sārddhaṃ śṛṇu nārada ..
jagāma śrīharirgehaṃ kuberabhavanopamam .. 183 ..
4.19.d:
श्रीनारायण उवाच ॥
दावाग्निमोक्षणं कृत्वा तैः सार्द्धं शृणु नारद ॥
जगाम श्रीहरिर्गेहं कुबेरभवनोपमम् ॥ 183 ॥
4.19.m:
Having granted deliverance from the forest fire, hear, O Nārada:
along with them Śrī Hari went home, which was like the palace of Kubera. / 183

4.19.s:
brāhmaṇebhyo dhanaṃ nandaḥ paripūrṇaṃ dadau mudā ..
bhojanaṃ kārayāmāsa jñātivargāṃśca bāndhavān .. 184 ..
4.19.d:
ब्राह्मणेभ्यो धनं नन्दः परिपूर्णं ददौ मुदा ॥
भोजनं कारयामास ज्ञातिवर्गांश्च बान्धवान् ॥ 184 ॥
4.19.m:
Nanda joyfully gave abundant wealth to the brāhmaṇas.
He fed the groups of kinsmen and relatives. / 184

4.19.s:
nānāvidhaṃ maṅgalaṃ ca harernāmānukīrtanam..
vedāṃśca pāṭhayāmāsa vipradvārā mudā'nvitaḥ .. 185 ..
4.19.d:
नानाविधं मङ्गलं च हरेर्नामानुकीर्तनम्॥
वेदांश्च पाठयामास विप्रद्वारा मुदाऽन्वितः ॥ 185 ॥
4.19.m:
There were various auspicious observances and the chanting of Hari's names,
and, filled with joy, he had the Vedas recited by the brāhmaṇas. / 185

4.19.s:
evaṃ mumudire sarve vṛndāraṇye gṛhegṛhe ..
śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇāmbhojadhyānaikatānamānasāḥ ..186..
4.19.d:
एवं मुमुदिरे सर्वे वृन्दारण्ये गृहेगृहे ॥
श्रीकृष्णचरणाम्भोजध्यानैकतानमानसाः ॥186॥
4.19.m:
Thus all rejoiced in house after house in Vṛndāvana,
their minds single-pointedly fixed in meditation on the lotus feet of Śrī Kṛṣṇa. / 186

4.19.s:
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ hareścaritamaṅgalam ..
kalikilbiṣakāṣṭhānāṃ dahane dahanopamam ..187..
4.19.d:
इत्येवं कथितं सर्वं हरेश्चरितमङ्गलम् ॥
कलिकिल्बिषकाष्ठानां दहने दहनोपमम् ॥187॥
4.19.m: which are like fire for burning the fuel of the sins of the Kali age. / 187

4.20.s:
4.20
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ..
ekadā bālakaiḥ sārddhaṃ balena saha mādhavaḥ..
bhuktvā pītvā'nuliptaśca vṛndāraṇyaṃ jagāma ha ..1..
4.20.d:
4.20
श्रीनारायण उवाच ॥
एकदा बालकैः सार्द्धं बलेन सह माधवः॥
भुक्त्वा पीत्वाऽनुलिप्तश्च वृन्दारण्यं जगाम ह ॥1॥

4.20.s:
krīḍāṃ cakāra bhagavānkautukena ca taiḥ saha ..
krīḍāni magnacittānāṃ dūraṃ tadgokulaṃ yayau .. 2 ..
4.20.d:
क्रीडां चकार भगवान्कौतुकेन च तैः सह ॥
क्रीडानि मग्नचित्तानां दूरं तद्गोकुलं ययौ ॥ 2 ॥

4.20.s:
tasya prabhāvaṃ vijñātuṃ vidhātā jagatāṃ patiḥ ..
cakāra nihnutiṃ gāśca vatsāṃśca bālakānapi .. 3 ..
4.20.d:
तस्य प्रभावं विज्ञातुं विधाता जगतां पतिः ॥
चकार निह्नुतिं गाश्च वत्सांश्च बालकानपि ॥ 3 ॥

4.20.s:
vijñāya tadabhiprāyaṃ sarvajñaḥ sarvakārakaḥ ..
punaścakāra tatsarvaṃ yogīndro yogamāyayā .. 4 ..
4.20.d:
विज्ञाय तदभिप्रायं सर्वज्ञः सर्वकारकः ॥
पुनश्चकार तत्सर्वं योगीन्द्रो योगमायया ॥ 4 ॥

4.20.s:
jagāma śrīharirgehaṃ kālayitvā ca gokulam ..
balena bālakaiḥ sārdhaṃ krīḍākautukamānasaḥ .. 5 ..
4.20.d:
जगाम श्रीहरिर्गेहं कालयित्वा च गोकुलम् ॥
बलेन बालकैः सार्धं क्रीडाकौतुकमानसः ॥ 5 ॥

4.20.s:
evaṃ cakāra bhagavānvarṣamekaṃ ca pratyaham ..
yamunāgamanaṃ gobhirbalena saha bālakaiḥ .. 6 ..
4.20.d:
एवं चकार भगवान्वर्षमेकं च प्रत्यहम् ॥
यमुनागमनं गोभिर्बलेन सह बालकैः ॥ 6 ॥

4.20.s:
brahmā prabhāvaṃ vijñāya lajjānamrātmakandharaḥ ..
ājagāma hareḥsthānaṃ bhāṇḍīravaṭamūlake .. 7 ..
4.20.d:
ब्रह्मा प्रभावं विज्ञाय लज्जानम्रात्मकन्धरः ॥
आजगाम हरेःस्थानं भाण्डीरवटमूलके ॥ 7 ॥

4.20.s:
dadarśa kṛṣṇaṃ tatraiva gopālagaṇaveṣṭitam ..
yathā pārvaṇacandraṃ ca vibhāntaṃ svagaṇaiḥ saha ..8..
4.20.d:
ददर्श कृष्णं तत्रैव गोपालगणवेष्टितम् ॥
यथा पार्वणचन्द्रं च विभान्तं स्वगणैः सह ॥8॥

4.20.s:
ratnasiṃhāsanasthaṃ ca hasantaṃ sasmitaṃ mudā..
pītavastraparīdhānaṃ jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā ..9..
4.20.d:
रत्नसिंहासनस्थं च हसन्तं सस्मितं मुदा॥
पीतवस्त्रपरीधानं ज्वलन्तं ब्रह्मतेजसा ॥9॥

4.20.s:
ratnakeyūravalayaratnamañjīrarañjitam..
ratnakuṇḍalayugmābhyāṃ svakapolasthalojjvalam .. 4.20.10 ..
4.20.d:
रत्नकेयूरवलयरत्नमञ्जीररञ्जितम्॥
रत्नकुण्डलयुग्माभ्यां स्वकपोलस्थलोज्ज्वलम् ॥ 4.20.10 ॥

4.20.s:
koṭikandarpalāvaṇyaṃ līlādhāmamanoharam ..
candanāgurukastūrīkuṅkumārcitavigraham .. 11 ..
4.20.d:
कोटिकन्दर्पलावण्यं लीलाधाममनोहरम् ॥
चन्दनागुरुकस्तूरीकुङ्कुमार्चितविग्रहम् ॥ 11 ॥

4.20.s:
pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālājālairvibhūṣitam ..
navīnanīradaśyāmaṃ prodbhinnanavayauvanam ..12..
4.20.d:
पारिजातप्रसूनानां मालाजालैर्विभूषितम् ॥
नवीननीरदश्यामं प्रोद्भिन्ननवयौवनम् ॥12॥
4.20.m: dark as a fresh raincloud, bursting with fresh youth, (12)

4.20.s:
mālatīmālyasaṃyuktaṃ mayūrapicchacūḍakam ..
svāṅgasaundaryadīptyā ca kṛtabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam .. 13 ..
4.20.d:
मालतीमाल्यसंयुक्तं मयूरपिच्छचूडकम् ॥
स्वाङ्गसौन्दर्यदीप्त्या च कृतभूषणभूषितम् ॥ 13 ॥
4.20.m:
joined with garlands of mālatī, with a crest of peacock feathers,
ornamenting his ornaments by the splendour of his own body's beauty, (13)

4.20.s:
śaratpārvaṇacandrasya prabhāmuṣṭāsyasundaram ..
pakvabimbādharauṣṭhaṃ ca khagendracañcunāsikam .. 14 ..
4.20.d:
शरत्पार्वणचन्द्रस्य प्रभामुष्टास्यसुन्दरम् ॥
पक्वबिम्बाधरौष्ठं च खगेन्द्रचञ्चुनासिकम् ॥ 14 ॥
4.20.m:
his lovely face stealing the splendour of an autumn full moon,
his lower lip like a ripe bimba fruit, his nose like the beak of the king of birds, (14)

4.20.s:
śaranmadhyāhnapadmānāṃ prabhāmocanalocanam..
muktāpaṅktivinindyaikadantapaṅktimanoharam ..15..
4.20.d:
शरन्मध्याह्नपद्मानां प्रभामोचनलोचनम्॥
मुक्तापङ्क्तिविनिन्द्यैकदन्तपङ्क्तिमनोहरम् ॥15॥
4.20.m: charming with a singular row of teeth that censures a row of pearls, (15)

4.20.s:
kaustubhena maṇīndreṇa vakṣaḥsthalasamujjvalam..
śāntaṃ ca rādhikākāntaṃ paripūrṇatamaṃ param..16..
4.20.d:
कौस्तुभेन मणीन्द्रेण वक्षःस्थलसमुज्ज्वलम्॥
शान्तं च राधिकाकान्तं परिपूर्णतमं परम्॥16॥
4.20.m: tranquil, beloved of Rādhikā, the most complete, supreme. (16)

4.20.s:
evaṃbhūtaṃ prabhuṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇanāmātivismitaḥ..
darśaṃdarśamīśvaraṃ taṃ praṇanāma punaḥpunaḥ..17..
4.20.d:
एवंभूतं प्रभुं दृष्ट्वा प्रणनामातिविस्मितः॥
दर्शंदर्शमीश्वरं तं प्रणनाम पुनःपुनः॥17॥
4.20.m:
Having seen the Lord thus, deeply astonished, he bowed down;
gazing again and again at that Sovereign, he bowed down repeatedly. (17)

4.20.s:
yaddṛṣṭaṃ hṛdayāmbhoje tadrūpaṃ bahireva ca ..
yā mūrtiḥ purato dṛṣṭā sā paścātparitastataḥ ..18..
4.20.d:
यद्दृष्टं हृदयाम्भोजे तद्रूपं बहिरेव च ॥
या मूर्तिः पुरतो दृष्टा सा पश्चात्परितस्ततः ॥18॥
4.20.m:
The very form seen within the lotus of the heart was seen outside as well;
the manifestation seen in front was seen behind and all around. (18)

4.20.s:
tatra vṛndāvane sarvaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇasamaṃ mune ..
dhyāyaṃdhyāyaṃ ca tadrūpaṃ tatra tasthau jagadguruḥ ..19..
4.20.d:
तत्र वृन्दावने सर्वं दृष्ट्वा कृष्णसमं मुने ॥
ध्यायंध्यायं च तद्रूपं तत्र तस्थौ जगद्गुरुः ॥19॥
4.20.m:
Seeing everything there in Vṛndāvana identical to Kṛṣṇa, O sage,
the world-guru stood there, meditating continuously on that form. (19)

4.20.s:
gāvo vatsāśca bālāśca latāgulmāśca vīrudhaḥ ..
sarvaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ brahmā śyāmarūpaṃ dadarśa ha ..4.20.20..
4.20.d:
गावो वत्साश्च बालाश्च लतागुल्माश्च वीरुधः ॥
सर्वं वृन्दावनं ब्रह्मा श्यामरूपं ददर्श ह ॥4.20.20॥
4.20.m:
The cows, calves, and boys, the creepers, shrubs, and plants—
Brahmā saw all of Vṛndāvana having the dark form [of Kṛṣṇa]. (20)

4.20.s:
dṛṣṭvaivaṃ paramāścaryaṃ punardhyānaṃ cakāra ha ..
dadarśa trijagadbrahmā nānyatkṛṣṇaṃ vinā mune..21..
4.20.d:
दृष्ट्वैवं परमाश्चर्यं पुनर्ध्यानं चकार ह ॥
ददर्श त्रिजगद्ब्रह्मा नान्यत्कृष्णं विना मुने॥21॥
4.20.m:
Having seen such a supreme wonder, he meditated once again;
Brahmā saw the three worlds [and] nothing else besides Kṛṣṇa, O sage. (21)

4.20.s:
kva ca vṛkṣaḥ kva vā śailaḥ kva mahī kva ca sāgarāḥ ..
kva devāḥ kva ca gandharvā munīndrāḥ kva ca mānavāḥ ..22..
4.20.d:
क्व च वृक्षः क्व वा शैलः क्व मही क्व च सागराः ॥
क्व देवाः क्व च गन्धर्वा मुनीन्द्राः क्व च मानवाः ॥22॥
4.20.m:
Where was any tree, where any mountain, where the earth, where the seas?
Where the gods, where the gandharvas, where the foremost sages, where human beings? (22)

4.20.s:
kva cātmā kva jagadbījaṃ kva svargaḥ kvāyameva ca..
sarvaṃ ca svadṛśā brahmā dadarśa māyayā hareḥ ..23..
4.20.d:
क्व चात्मा क्व जगद्बीजं क्व स्वर्गः क्वायमेव च॥
सर्वं च स्वदृशा ब्रह्मा ददर्श मायया हरेः ॥23॥
4.20.m:
Where was the Self, where the seed of the universe, where heaven, and where this very [world]?
Brahmā saw all this with his own eyes through Hari's māyā. (23)

4.20.s:
kva kṛṣṇo jagatāṃ nāthaḥ kva vā māyāvibhūtayaḥ ..
sarvaṃ kṛṣṇamayaṃ dṛṣṭvā kiṃcinnirvaktumakṣamaḥ .. 24 ..
4.20.d:
क्व कृष्णो जगतां नाथः क्व वा मायाविभूतयः ॥
सर्वं कृष्णमयं दृष्ट्वा किंचिन्निर्वक्तुमक्षमः ॥ 24 ॥
4.20.m:
Where was Kṛṣṇa, the master of the worlds, and where were the manifestations of māyā?
Seeing everything composed of Kṛṣṇa, he was unable to utter anything. (24)

4.20.s:
kiṃ staumi kiṃ karomīti manasaivaṃ pragṛhya ca ..
tatra sthitvā jagaddhātā japaṃ kartuṃ samudyataḥ .. 25 ..
4.20.d:
किं स्तौमि किं करोमीति मनसैवं प्रगृह्य च ॥
तत्र स्थित्वा जगद्धाता जपं कर्तुं समुद्यतः ॥ 25 ॥
4.20.m:
Grasping in his mind, “What shall I praise? What shall I do?”,
and standing there, the creator of the world prepared to recite [his] mantra. (25)

4.20.s:
sukhaṃ yogāsanaṃ kṛtvā babhūva saṃpuṭāñjaliḥ ..
pulakāṅkitasarvāṅgaḥ sāśrunetro'tidīnavat .. 26 ..
4.20.d:
सुखं योगासनं कृत्वा बभूव संपुटाञ्जलिः ॥
पुलकाङ्कितसर्वाङ्गः साश्रुनेत्रोऽतिदीनवत् ॥ 26 ॥
4.20.m:
Assuming a comfortable yoga posture, he cupped his hands in reverence,
his entire body bristling with thrilling hair, his eyes filled with tears, exceedingly humble. (26)

4.20.s:
iḍāṃ suṣumnāṃ madhyāṃ ca piṅgalāṃ nalinīṃ dhurām ..
nāḍīṣaṭkaṃ ca yogena nibaddhya ca prayatnataḥ .. 27 ..
4.20.d:
इडां सुषुम्नां मध्यां च पिङ्गलां नलिनीं धुराम् ॥
नाडीषट्कं च योगेन निबद्ध्य च प्रयत्नतः ॥ 27 ॥
4.20.m:
The Iḍā, Suṣumnā, the middle channel, Piṅgalā, Nalinī, and Dhurā—
carefully binding the six subtle channels through yoga, (27)

4.20.s:
mūlādhāraṃ svādhiṣṭhānaṃ maṇipūraṃ manoharam ..
viśuddhaṃ paramājñākhyaṃ ṣaṭcakraṃ ca nibaddhya ca .. 28 ..
4.20.d:
मूलाधारं स्वाधिष्ठानं मणिपूरं मनोहरम् ॥
विशुद्धं परमाज्ञाख्यं षट्चक्रं च निबद्ध्य च ॥ 28 ॥
4.20.m:
the Mūlādhāra, Svādhiṣṭhāna, charming Maṇipūra,
Viśuddha, and the supreme called Ājñā—binding the six cakras, (28)

4.20.s:
laṅghanaṃ kārayitvā ca tatṣaṭcakraṃ kramādvidhiḥ..
brahmarandhraṃ samānīya vāyubandhaṃ cakāra ha..29..
4.20.d:
लङ्घनं कारयित्वा च तत्षट्चक्रं क्रमाद्विधिः॥
ब्रह्मरन्ध्रं समानीय वायुबन्धं चकार ह॥29॥
4.20.m:
and making [the breath] ascend those six cakras in order, the Creator
brought it to the brahmarandhra and bound the breath. (29)

4.20.s:
nibadhya vāyuṃ madhyāṃ tāmānīya hṛdayāmbujam..
taṃ vāyuṃ bhrāmayitvā ca yojayāmāsa madhyayā .. 4.20.30 ..
4.20.d:
निबध्य वायुं मध्यां तामानीय हृदयाम्बुजम्॥
तं वायुं भ्रामयित्वा च योजयामास मध्यया ॥ 4.20.30 ॥
4.20.m:
Having bound the breath and brought that central channel to the lotus of the heart,
circulating that breath, he joined it with the central channel. (30)

4.20.s:
evaṃ kṛtvā tu niṣpando yo datto hariṇā purā ..
jajāpa paramaṃ mantraṃ tasyaiva ca daśākṣaram ..31..
4.20.d:
एवं कृत्वा तु निष्पन्दो यो दत्तो हरिणा पुरा ॥
जजाप परमं मन्त्रं तस्यैव च दशाक्षरम् ॥31॥
4.20.m:
Having done this and becoming motionless, [that] supreme ten-syllable mantra
which was previously given by Hari—he chanted that very mantra of his. (31)

4.20.s:
muhūrtaṃ ca japaṃ kṛtvā dhyāyaṃdhyāyaṃ padāmbujam ..
dadarśa hṛdayāmbhoje sarvatejomayaṃ mune ..32..
4.20.d:
मुहूर्तं च जपं कृत्वा ध्यायंध्यायं पदाम्बुजम् ॥
ददर्श हृदयाम्भोजे सर्वतेजोमयं मुने ॥32॥
4.20.m:
Reciting for a muhūrta, repeatedly meditating on the lotus feet,
he saw in the lotus of his heart [a vision] consisting wholly of splendour, O sage. (32)

4.20.s:
tattejaso'ntare rūpamatīva sumanoharam ..
dvibhujaṃ muralīhastaṃ bhūṣitaṃ pītavāsasā .. 33 ..
4.20.d:
तत्तेजसोऽन्तरे रूपमतीव सुमनोहरम् ॥
द्विभुजं मुरलीहस्तं भूषितं पीतवाससा ॥ 33 ॥
4.20.m:
Within that splendour [he saw] an exceedingly captivating form:
two-armed, holding a flute, adorned with yellow garments, (33)

4.20.s:
śrutimūlasthalanyastajvalanmakarakuṇḍalam ..
īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyaṃ bhaktānugrahakātaram .. 34 ..
4.20.d:
श्रुतिमूलस्थलन्यस्तज्वलन्मकरकुण्डलम् ॥
ईषद्धास्यप्रसन्नास्यं भक्तानुग्रहकातरम् ॥ 34 ॥
4.20.m: with gleaming makara-shaped earrings set at the base of his ears,

4.20.s:
yaddṛṣṭaṃ brahmarandhre ca hṛdi tadbahireva ca ..
dṛṣṭvā ca paramāścaryaṃ tuṣṭāva parameśvaram ..35..
4.20.d:
यद्दृष्टं ब्रह्मरन्ध्रे च हृदि तद्बहिरेव च ॥
दृष्ट्वा च परमाश्चर्यं तुष्टाव परमेश्वरम् ॥35॥
4.20.m:
What was seen in the brahmarandhra and in the heart was seen outside as well;
seeing this supreme wonder, he praised the Supreme Lord (35)

4.20.s:
yatstotraṃ ca purā dattaṃ hariṇaikārṇave mune ..
tamīśaṃ tena vidhinā bhaktinamrātmakandharaḥ .. 36 ..
4.20.d:
यत्स्तोत्रं च पुरा दत्तं हरिणैकार्णवे मुने ॥
तमीशं तेन विधिना भक्तिनम्रात्मकन्धरः ॥ 36 ॥
4.20.m:
with the hymn of praise previously given by Hari in the single primordial ocean, O sage. [… /]
[Brahmā praised] that Lord in that manner, his neck bowed in devotion. (36)

4.20.s:
brahmovāca ..
sarvasvarūpaṃ sarveśaṃ sarvakāraṇakāraṇam ..
sarvānirvacanīyaṃ taṃ namāmi śivarūpiṇam .. 37 ..
4.20.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच ॥
सर्वस्वरूपं सर्वेशं सर्वकारणकारणम् ॥
सर्वानिर्वचनीयं तं नमामि शिवरूपिणम् ॥ 37 ॥
4.20.m:
I bow to him whose form is all, the Lord of all, the cause of all causes,
who cannot be described by anyone, whose form is auspicious. (37)

4.20.s:
navīnajaladākāraṃ śyāmasundaravigraham ..
sthitaṃ jantuṣu sarveṣu nirliptaṃ sākṣirūpiṇam .. 38 ..
4.20.d:
नवीनजलदाकारं श्यामसुन्दरविग्रहम् ॥
स्थितं जन्तुषु सर्वेषु निर्लिप्तं साक्षिरूपिणम् ॥ 38 ॥
4.20.m:
Whose appearance is like a fresh raincloud, whose body is dark and handsome,
dwelling in all living beings, untainted, in the form of the witness. (38)

4.20.s:
svātmārāmaṃ pūrṇakāmaṃ jagadvyāpijagatparam ..
sarvasvarūpaṃ sarveṣāṃ bījarūpaṃ sanātanam .. 39 ..
4.20.d:
स्वात्मारामं पूर्णकामं जगद्व्यापिजगत्परम् ॥
सर्वस्वरूपं सर्वेषां बीजरूपं सनातनम् ॥ 39 ॥
4.20.m:
Delighting in himself, whose desires are fulfilled, pervading the universe, beyond the universe,
having the form of everything, the seed-form of all, eternal. (39)

4.20.s:
sarvādhāraṃ sarvavaraṃ sarvaśaktisamanvitam ..
sarvārādhyaṃ sarvaguruṃ sarvamaṅgalakāraṇam .. 4.20.40 ..
4.20.d:
सर्वाधारं सर्ववरं सर्वशक्तिसमन्वितम् ॥
सर्वाराध्यं सर्वगुरुं सर्वमङ्गलकारणम् ॥ 4.20.40 ॥
4.20.m:
The support of all, the best of all, endowed with all powers,
worshipped by all, the guru of all, the cause of all auspiciousness. (40)

4.20.s:
sarvamaṃtrasvarūpaṃ ca sarvasaṃpatkaraṃ varam ..
śaktiyuktamayuktaṃ ca staumi svecchāmayaṃ vibhum .. 41 ..
4.20.d:
सर्वमंत्रस्वरूपं च सर्वसंपत्करं वरम् ॥
शक्तियुक्तमयुक्तं च स्तौमि स्वेच्छामयं विभुम् ॥ 41 ॥
4.20.m:
Whose form is all mantras, bestowing all prosperity, the supreme one,
joined with power and free from it, I praise the all-pervading Lord whose nature is his own will. (41)

4.20.s:
śaktīśaṃ śaktibījaṃ ca śaktirūpadharaṃ varam ..
saṃsārasāgare ghore śaktinaukāsamanvitam .. 42 ..
4.20.d:
शक्तीशं शक्तिबीजं च शक्तिरूपधरं वरम् ॥
संसारसागरे घोरे शक्तिनौकासमन्वितम् ॥ 42 ॥
4.20.m:
Lord of power, seed of power, bearing the form of power, the excellent one,
endowed with the boat of power across the terrible ocean of cyclic existence. (42)

4.20.s:
kṛpāluṃ karṇadhāraṃ ca namāmi bhaktavatsalam ..
ātmasvarūpamekāṃtaṃ liptaṃ nirliptameva ca ..43..
4.20.d:
कृपालुं कर्णधारं च नमामि भक्तवत्सलम् ॥
आत्मस्वरूपमेकांतं लिप्तं निर्लिप्तमेव च ॥43॥
4.20.m:
I bow to the compassionate helmsman, who is affectionate to his devotees,
whose nature is the Self, solitary, both attached and unattached. (43)

4.20.s:
